import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
from torchvision import transforms


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        if self.downsample:
            identity = self.downsample(identity)
        out += identity
        return self.relu(out)

    def __init__(self):

            Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename))
            .convert("L")
            .resize(TARGET_SIZE, Image.BILINEAR)
        )
        clean_img = (
            Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename))
            .convert("L")
            .resize(TARGET_SIZE, Image.BILINEAR)
        )
        # Convert to normalized tensors
        noisy_arr = np.array(noisy_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        clean_arr = np.array(clean_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        return (
            torch.tensor(noisy_arr).unsqueeze(0),
            torch.tensor(clean_arr).unsqueeze(0),
        )

        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv3 = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 3, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.relu1(self.conv1(x))

        self.upconv = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = self.block(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def block(self, in_c, out_c):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool(enc1))
        dec = self.upconv(enc2)
        dec = torch.cat([dec, enc1], dim=1)
        dec = self.dec1(dec)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(dec))

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        if self.downsample:
            identity = self.downsample(identity)
        out += identity
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):

        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)

        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(b), e3], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), e2], 1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), e1], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)

        # Decoder
        self.upconv3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        e4 = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))

        # Decoder
        d3 = self.upconv3(e4)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3, e3], dim=1)
        d3 = self.dec3(d3)

        d2 = self.upconv2(d3)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e2], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)

        d1 = self.upconv1(d2)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e1], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)

        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(d1))

class AttentionGate(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
        )
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
        )
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_channels, 1, kernel_size=1), nn.Sigmoid())
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return g * psi

        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)

        # Decoder with attention gates
        self.upconv3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.att3 = AttentionGate(256)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.att2 = AttentionGate(128)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.att1 = AttentionGate(64)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        e4 = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))

        # Decoder
        d3_up = self.upconv3(e4)
        att3 = self.att3(e3, d3_up)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3_up, att3], dim=1)
        d3 = self.dec3(d3)

        d2_up = self.upconv2(d3)
        att2 = self.att2(e2, d2_up)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2_up, att2], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)

        d1_up = self.upconv1(d2)
        att1 = self.att1(e1, d1_up)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1_up, att1], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)

        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(d1))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, crop_size=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.crop_size = crop_size
        self.transform = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomCrop(crop_size),
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                    transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(),
                ]
            )
            if crop_size
            else None
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename)).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename)).convert("L")

        if self.transform:
            seed = torch.randint(0, 1000000, (1,)).item()
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy_img = self.transform(noisy_img)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            clean_img = self.transform(clean_img)
        else:

            def pad_image(img):
                w, h = img.size
                pad_w = (8 - (w % 8)) % 8
                pad_h = (8 - (h % 8)) % 8
                return transforms.functional.pad(
                    img, (0, 0, pad_w, pad_h), padding_mode="reflect"
                )

            noisy_img = pad_image(noisy_img)
            clean_img = pad_image(clean_img)

        noisy = torch.tensor(
            np.array(noisy_img) / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32
        ).unsqueeze(0)
        clean = torch.tensor(
            np.array(clean_img) / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32
        ).unsqueeze(0)
        return noisy, clean

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
from torchvision import transforms
from torchvision.transforms import (
    RandomHorizontalFlip,
    RandomVerticalFlip,
    RandomRotation,
    RandomCrop,
    CenterCrop,
)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, transform=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.filenames = [f for f in os.listdir(noisy_dir) if f.endswith(".png")]

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy_path = os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.filenames[idx])
        clean_path = os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.filenames[idx])

        noisy_img = Image.open(noisy_path).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(clean_path).convert("L")

        if self.transform:
            seed = torch.randint(0, 2**32, ())
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy_img = self.transform(noisy_img)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            clean_img = self.transform(clean_img)

        noisy_tensor = transforms.ToTensor()(noisy_img)
        clean_tensor = transforms.ToTensor()(clean_img)
        residual = noisy_tensor - clean_tensor
        return noisy_tensor, residual


class DnCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        layers = [nn.Conv2d(1, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(inplace=True)]
        for _ in range(15):
            layers += [
                nn.Conv2d(64, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            ]
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(64, 1, kernel_size=3, padding=1))
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


def main():
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    batch_size = 16
    num_epochs = 30
    crop_size = 256

    if os.path.exists("best_model.pth"):
        os.remove("best_model.pth")

    transform_train = transforms.Compose(
        [
            RandomHorizontalFlip(),
            RandomVerticalFlip(),
            RandomRotation(10),
            RandomCrop(crop_size),
        ]
    )

    transform_val = transforms.Compose([CenterCrop(crop_size)])

    full_dataset = DenoisingDataset(
        noisy_dir="input/train",
        clean_dir="input/train_cleaned",
        transform=transform_train,
    )

    train_size = int(0.8 * len(full_dataset))
    val_size = len(full_dataset) - train_size
    train_dataset, val_dataset = random_split(full_dataset, [train_size, val_size])
    val_dataset.dataset.transform = transform_val

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4
    )

    model = DnCNN().to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
    criterion = nn.MSELoss()

    best_rmse = float("inf")
    for epoch in range(num_epochs):
        model.train()
        train_loss = 0.0
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            train_loss += loss.item() * inputs.size(0)
        train_loss /= len(train_loader.dataset)

        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for inputs, targets in val_loader:
                inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
                outputs = model(inputs)
                val_loss += criterion(outputs, targets).item() * inputs.size(0)
        val_loss /= len(val_loader.dataset)
        val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss)
        print(
            f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {train_loss:.5f} | Val RMSE: {val_rmse:.5f}"
        )
        if val_rmse < best_rmse:
            best_rmse = val_rmse
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

    print(f"Best Validation RMSE: {best_rmse:.5f}")

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
    model.eval()

    submission = []
    test_dir = "input/test"
    transform = transforms.ToTensor()
    for filename in os.listdir(test_dir):
        if not filename.endswith(".png"):
            continue
        img_path = os.path.join(test_dir, filename)
        img = Image.open(img_path).convert("L")
        img_tensor = transform(img).unsqueeze(0).to(device)

        with torch.no_grad():
            residual = model(img_tensor)
        denoised = torch.clamp(img_tensor - residual, 0, 1).squeeze().cpu().numpy()

        h, w = denoised.shape
        image_id = os.path.splitext(filename)[0]
        rows, cols = np.indices((h, w))
        pixel_ids = [
            f"{image_id}_{r+1}_{c+1}" for r, c in zip(rows.ravel(), cols.ravel())
        ]
        values = denoised.ravel()

        submission.extend(zip(pixel_ids, values))

    df = pd.DataFrame(submission, columns=["id", "value"])
    os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
    df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os

from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from collections import OrderedDict
import pandas as pd

TARGET_SIZE = (540, 420)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_img = (
            Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename))
            .convert("L")
            .resize(TARGET_SIZE, Image.BICUBIC)
        )
        clean_img = (
            Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename))
            .convert("L")
            .resize(TARGET_SIZE, Image.BICUBIC)
        )
        return (
            torch.tensor(np.array(noisy_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0).unsqueeze(0),
            torch.tensor(np.array(clean_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0).unsqueeze(0),
        )


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=1, out_channels=1, init_features=32):
        super().__init__()
        features = init_features

        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self._block(in_channels, features, "enc1")
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = self._block(features, features * 2, "enc2")
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = self._block(features * 2, features * 4, "bottleneck")

        # Decoder
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 4, features * 2, 2, 2)
        self.dec2 = self._block(features * 4, features * 2, "dec2")
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 2, features, 2, 2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(features * 2, features, "dec1")

        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(features, out_channels, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def _block(self, in_ch, out_ch, name):
        return nn.Sequential(
            OrderedDict(
                [
                    (
                        f"{name}_conv1",
                        nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                    ),
                    (f"{name}_bn1", nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)),
                    (f"{name}_relu1", nn.ReLU(inplace=True)),
                    (
                        f"{name}_conv2",
                        nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                    ),
                    (f"{name}_bn2", nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)),
                    (f"{name}_relu2", nn.ReLU(inplace=True)),
                ]
            )
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(enc1))

        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(enc2))

        dec2 = self.upconv2(bottleneck)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)
        dec2 = self.dec2(dec2)

        dec1 = self.upconv1(dec2)
        dec1 = torch.cat((dec1, enc1), dim=1)
        dec1 = self.dec1(dec1)

        return self.sigmoid(self.conv(dec1))

train_dir = "input/train"

import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torchvision import transforms
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import pandas as pd
import torch.nn.functional as F


class SSIM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = self.create_window(window_size, sigma)
        self.window_size = window_size

    def gaussian(self, window_size, sigma):
        gauss = torch.exp(
            -((torch.arange(window_size) - window_size // 2) ** 2) / (2 * sigma**2)
        )
        return gauss / gauss.sum()

    def create_window(self, window_size, sigma):
        _1D = self.gaussian(window_size, sigma)
        _2D = _1D.unsqueeze(1) * _1D.unsqueeze(0)
        return _2D[None, None, ...].float()

    def forward(self, img1, img2):
        window = self.window.to(img1.device)
        mu1 = F.conv2d(img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)

        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu1_mu2 = mu1 * mu2

        sigma1_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
            - mu1_sq
        )
        sigma2_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img2 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
            - mu2_sq
        )
        sigma12 = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
            - mu1_mu2
        )

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2

        ssim_map = ((2 * mu1_mu2 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
        )
        return ssim_map.mean()


class AttentionGate(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
        )
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
        )
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_channels, 1, kernel_size=1), nn.Sigmoid())
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return g * psi


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)
        self.upconv3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.att3 = AttentionGate(256)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.att2 = AttentionGate(128)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.att1 = AttentionGate(64)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        e4 = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))

        d3_up = self.upconv3(e4)
        att3 = self.att3(e3, d3_up)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3_up, att3], dim=1)
        d3 = self.dec3(d3)

        d2_up = self.upconv2(d3)
        att2 = self.att2(e2, d2_up)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2_up, att2], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)

        d1_up = self.upconv1(d2)
        att1 = self.att1(e1, d1_up)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1_up, att1], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)

        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(d1))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, crop_size=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.crop_size = crop_size
        self.transform = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomCrop(crop_size),
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                    transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(),
                ]
            )
            if crop_size
            else None
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename)).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename)).convert("L")

        if self.transform:
            seed = torch.randint(0, 1000000, (1,)).item()
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy_img = self.transform(noisy_img)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            clean_img = self.transform(clean_img)
        else:

            def pad_image(img):
                w, h = img.size
                pad_w = (8 - (w % 8)) % 8
                pad_h = (8 - (h % 8)) % 8
                return transforms.functional.pad(
                    img, (0, 0, pad_w, pad_h), padding_mode="reflect"
                )

            noisy_img = pad_image(noisy_img)
            clean_img = pad_image(clean_img)

        noisy = torch.tensor(
            np.array(noisy_img) / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32
        ).unsqueeze(0)
        clean = torch.tensor(
            np.array(clean_img) / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32
        ).unsqueeze(0)
        return noisy, clean

import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from collections import OrderedDict
import pandas as pd

TARGET_SIZE = (544, 416)  # Adjusted for 4 downsampling steps


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_img = (
            Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename))
            .convert("L")
            .resize(TARGET_SIZE, Image.BICUBIC)
        )
        clean_img = (
            Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename))
            .convert("L")
            .resize(TARGET_SIZE, Image.BICUBIC)
        )
        return (
            torch.tensor(np.array(noisy_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0).unsqueeze(0),
            torch.tensor(np.array(clean_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0).unsqueeze(0),
        )


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=1, out_channels=1, init_features=32):
        super().__init__()
        features = init_features

        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self._block(in_channels, features, "enc1")
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = self._block(features, features * 2, "enc2")
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = self._block(features * 2, features * 4, "enc3")
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc4 = self._block(features * 4, features * 8, "enc4")
        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = self._block(features * 8, features * 16, "bottleneck")

        # Decoder
        self.upconv4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 16, features * 8, 2, 2)
        self.dec4 = self._block(features * 16, features * 8, "dec4")
        self.upconv3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 8, features * 4, 2, 2)
        self.dec3 = self._block(features * 8, features * 4, "dec3")
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 4, features * 2, 2, 2)
        self.dec2 = self._block(features * 4, features * 2, "dec2")
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 2, features, 2, 2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(features * 2, features, "dec1")

        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(features, out_channels, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def _block(self, in_ch, out_ch, name):
        return nn.Sequential(
            OrderedDict(
                [
                    (
                        f"{name}_conv1",
                        nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                    ),
                    (f"{name}_bn1", nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)),
                    (f"{name}_relu1", nn.ReLU(inplace=True)),
                    (
                        f"{name}_conv2",
                        nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                    ),
                    (f"{name}_bn2", nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)),
                    (f"{name}_relu2", nn.ReLU(inplace=True)),
                ]
            )
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(enc1))
        enc3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(enc2))
        enc4 = self.enc4(self.pool3(enc3))

        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool4(enc4))

        dec4 = self.upconv4(bottleneck)
        dec4 = torch.cat((dec4, enc4), dim=1)
        dec4 = self.dec4(dec4)

        dec3 = self.upconv3(dec4)
        dec3 = torch.cat((dec3, enc3), dim=1)
        dec3 = self.dec3(dec3)

        dec2 = self.upconv2(dec3)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torchvision import transforms
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import pandas as pd
import torch.nn.functional as F


class GradientLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.sobel_x = torch.tensor(
            [[1, 0, -1], [2, 0, -2], [1, 0, -1]], dtype=torch.float32
        ).view(1, 1, 3, 3)
        self.sobel_y = torch.tensor(
            [[1, 2, 1], [0, 0, 0], [-1, -2, -1]], dtype=torch.float32
        ).view(1, 1, 3, 3)

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        self.sobel_x = self.sobel_x.to(pred.device)
        self.sobel_y = self.sobel_y.to(pred.device)

        grad_pred_x = F.conv2d(pred, self.sobel_x, padding=1)
        grad_pred_y = F.conv2d(pred, self.sobel_y, padding=1)
        grad_target_x = F.conv2d(target, self.sobel_x, padding=1)
        grad_target_y = F.conv2d(target, self.sobel_y, padding=1)

        loss_x = F.l1_loss(grad_pred_x, grad_target_x)
        loss_y = F.l1_loss(grad_pred_y, grad_target_y)
        return (loss_x + loss_y) / 2


class SSIM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = self.create_window(window_size, sigma)
        self.window_size = window_size

    def gaussian(self, window_size, sigma):
        gauss = torch.exp(
            -((torch.arange(window_size) - window_size // 2) ** 2) / (2 * sigma**2)
        )
        return gauss / gauss.sum()

    def create_window(self, window_size, sigma):
        _1D = self.gaussian(window_size, sigma)
        _2D = _1D.unsqueeze(1) * _1D.unsqueeze(0)
        return _2D[None, None, ...].float()

    def forward(self, img1, img2):
        window = self.window.to(img1.device)
        mu1 = F.conv2d(img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)

        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu1_mu2 = mu1 * mu2

        sigma1_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
            - mu1_sq
        )
        sigma2_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img2 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
            - mu2_sq
        )
        sigma12 = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
            - mu1_mu2
        )

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2

        ssim_map = ((2 * mu1_mu2 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
        )
        return ssim_map.mean()


class AttentionGate(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
        )
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(in_channels),
        )
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_channels, 1, kernel_size=1), nn.Sigmoid())
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return g * psi


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)
        self.upconv3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.att3 = AttentionGate(256)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.att2 = AttentionGate(128)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.att1 = AttentionGate(64)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        e4 = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))

        d3_up = self.upconv3(e4)
        att3 = self.att3(e3, d3_up)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3_up, att3], dim=1)
        d3 = self.dec3(d3)

        d2_up = self.upconv2(d3)
        att2 = self.att2(e2, d2_up)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2_up, att2], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)

        d1_up = self.upconv1(d2)
        att1 = self.att1(e1, d1_up)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1_up, att1], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)

        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(d1))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, crop_size=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.crop_size = crop_size
        self.transform = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomCrop(crop_size),
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                    transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(),
                ]
            )
            if crop_size
            else None
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename)).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename)).convert("L")

        if self.transform:
            seed = torch.randint(0, 1000000, (1,)).item()
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy_img = self.transform(noisy_img)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            clean_img = self.transform(clean_img)
        else:

            def pad_image(img):
                w, h = img.size
                pad_w = (8 - (w % 8)) % 8
                pad_h = (8 - (h % 8)) % 8
                return transforms.functional.pad(
                    img, (0, 0, pad_w, pad_h), padding_mode="reflect"
                )

            noisy_img = pad_image(noisy_img)
            clean_img = pad_image(clean_img)

        noisy = torch.tensor(
            np.array(noisy_img) / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32
        ).unsqueeze(0)
        clean = torch.tensor(
            np.array(clean_img) / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32
        ).unsqueeze(0)
        return noisy, clean

TARGET_SIZE = (544, 416)


class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, F_g, F_l, F_int):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_g, F_int, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int)
        )
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_l, F_int, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int)
        )
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return x * psi


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=1, out_channels=1, init_features=32):
        super().__init__()
        features = init_features

        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self._block(in_channels, features, "enc1")
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = self._block(features, features * 2, "enc2")
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = self._block(features * 2, features * 4, "enc3")
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc4 = self._block(features * 4, features * 8, "enc4")
        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = self._block(features * 8, features * 16, "bottleneck")

        # Decoder with attention
        self.upconv4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 16, features * 8, 2, 2)
        self.att4 = AttentionBlock(
            F_g=features * 8, F_l=features * 8, F_int=features * 4
        )
        self.dec4 = self._block(features * 16, features * 8, "dec4")

        self.upconv3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 8, features * 4, 2, 2)
        self.att3 = AttentionBlock(
            F_g=features * 4, F_l=features * 4, F_int=features * 2
        )
        self.dec3 = self._block(features * 8, features * 4, "dec3")

        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 4, features * 2, 2, 2)
        self.att2 = AttentionBlock(F_g=features * 2, F_l=features * 2, F_int=features)
        self.dec2 = self._block(features * 4, features * 2, "dec2")

        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 2, features, 2, 2)
        self.att1 = AttentionBlock(F_g=features, F_l=features, F_int=features // 2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(features * 2, features, "dec1")

        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(features, out_channels, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def _block(self, in_ch, out_ch, name):
        return nn.Sequential(
            OrderedDict(
                [
                    (
                        f"{name}_conv1",
                        nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                    ),
                    (f"{name}_bn1", nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)),
                    (f"{name}_relu1", nn.ReLU(inplace=True)),
                    (
                        f"{name}_conv2",
                        nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                    ),
                    (f"{name}_bn2", nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)),
                    (f"{name}_relu2", nn.ReLU(inplace=True)),
                ]
            )
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(enc1))
        enc3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(enc2))
        enc4 = self.enc4(self.pool3(enc3))

        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool4(enc4))

        dec4 = self.upconv4(bottleneck)
        enc4 = self.att4(dec4, enc4)
        dec4 = torch.cat((dec4, enc4), dim=1)
        dec4 = self.dec4(dec4)

        dec3 = self.upconv3(dec4)
        enc3 = self.att3(dec3, enc3)
        dec3 = torch.cat((dec3, enc3), dim=1)
        dec3 = self.dec3(dec3)

        dec2 = self.upconv2(dec3)
        enc2 = self.att2(dec2, enc2)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)
        dec2 = self.dec2(dec2)

        dec1 = self.upconv1(dec2)
        enc1 = self.att1(dec1, enc1)
        dec1 = torch.cat((dec1, enc1), dim=1)
        dec1 = self.dec1(dec1)

        return self.sigmoid(self.conv(dec1))

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.shortcut = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else nn.Identity()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(enc1))
        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(enc2))

        # Decoder
        dec = self.upconv1(bottleneck)
        dec = torch.cat([dec, enc2], dim=1)
        dec = self.dec1(dec)
        dec = self.upconv2(dec)
        dec = torch.cat([dec, enc1], dim=1)
        dec = self.dec2(dec)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(dec))

class DnCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, depth=17, n_channels=64):
        super(DnCNN, self).__init__()
        layers = [
            nn.Conv2d(1, n_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        ]
        for _ in range(depth - 2):
            layers += [
                nn.Conv2d(n_channels, n_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(n_channels),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            ]
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(n_channels, 1, 3, padding=1, bias=False))
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, file_list, transform=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.files = file_list
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.files[idx])).convert("L")
        clean = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.files[idx])).convert("L")
        if self.transform:
            noisy = self.transform(noisy)
            clean = self.transform(clean)
        return noisy, clean

val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=8, shuffle=False, num_workers=4)

TARGET_SIZE = (544, 416)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames

        clean_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename)).convert("L")

        # Resize and normalize
        noisy_img = noisy_img.resize(TARGET_SIZE, Image.BICUBIC)
        clean_img = clean_img.resize(TARGET_SIZE, Image.BICUBIC)

        noisy_arr = np.array(noisy_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        clean_arr = np.array(clean_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0

        return (
            torch.tensor(noisy_arr).unsqueeze(0),
            torch.tensor(clean_arr).unsqueeze(0),
        )


class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, F_g, F_l, F_int):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_g, F_int, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int)
        )
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_l, F_int, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int)
        )
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return x * psi


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=1, out_channels=1, init_features=32):
        super().__init__()
        features = init_features

        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self._block(in_channels, features, "enc1")
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = self._block(features, features * 2, "enc2")
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = self._block(features * 2, features * 4, "enc3")
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc4 = self._block(features * 4, features * 8, "enc4")
        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = self._block(features * 8, features * 16, "bottleneck")

        # Decoder with attention
        self.upconv4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 16, features * 8, 2, 2)
        self.att4 = AttentionBlock(
            F_g=features * 8, F_l=features * 8, F_int=features * 4
        )
        self.dec4 = self._block(features * 16, features * 8, "dec4")

        self.upconv3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 8, features * 4, 2, 2)
        self.att3 = AttentionBlock(
            F_g=features * 4, F_l=features * 4, F_int=features * 2
        )
        self.dec3 = self._block(features * 8, features * 4, "dec3")

        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 4, features * 2, 2, 2)
        self.att2 = AttentionBlock(F_g=features * 2, F_l=features * 2, F_int=features)
        self.dec2 = self._block(features * 4, features * 2, "dec2")

        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 2, features, 2, 2)
        self.att1 = AttentionBlock(F_g=features, F_l=features, F_int=features // 2)
        self.dec1 = self._block(features * 2, features, "dec1")

        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(features, out_channels, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def _block(self, in_ch, out_ch, name):
        return nn.Sequential(
            OrderedDict(
                [
                    (
                        f"{name}_conv1",
                        nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                    ),
                    (f"{name}_bn1", nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)),
                    (f"{name}_relu1", nn.ReLU(inplace=True)),
                    (
                        f"{name}_conv2",
                        nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                    ),
                    (f"{name}_bn2", nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)),
                    (f"{name}_relu2", nn.ReLU(inplace=True)),
                ]
            )
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(enc1))
        enc3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(enc2))
        enc4 = self.enc4(self.pool3(enc3))

        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool4(enc4))

        dec4 = self.upconv4(bottleneck)
        enc4 = self.att4(dec4, enc4)
        dec4 = torch.cat((dec4, enc4), dim=1)
        dec4 = self.dec4(dec4)

        dec3 = self.upconv3(dec4)
        enc3 = self.att3(dec3, enc3)
        dec3 = torch.cat((dec3, enc3), dim=1)
        dec3 = self.dec3(dec3)

        dec2 = self.upconv2(dec3)
        enc2 = self.att2(dec2, enc2)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)
        dec2 = self.dec2(dec2)

        dec1 = self.upconv1(dec2)
        enc1 = self.att1(dec1, enc1)
        dec1 = torch.cat((dec1, enc1), dim=1)
        dec1 = self.dec1(dec1)

        return self.sigmoid(self.conv(dec1))

clean_dir = "input/train_cleaned"

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torchvision import transforms
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import pandas as pd


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.shortcut = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else nn.Identity()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(
            256, 128, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1
        )
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(
            128, 64, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1
        )
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(enc1))
        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(enc2))

        dec = self.upconv1(bottleneck)
        dec = torch.cat([dec, enc2], dim=1)
        dec = self.dec1(dec)
        dec = self.upconv2(dec)
        dec = torch.cat([dec, enc1], dim=1)
        dec = self.dec2(dec)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(dec))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, crop_size=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.crop_size = crop_size
        self.transform = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomCrop(crop_size),
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                    transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(),
                ]
            )
            if crop_size
            else None
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename)).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename)).convert("L")

        if self.transform:
            seed = torch.randint(0, 1000000, (1,)).item()
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy_img = self.transform(noisy_img)

import os

from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
from torchvision import transforms


class AttentionGate(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, F_g, F_l, F_int):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_g, F_int, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int),
        )
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_l, F_int, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int),
        )
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return x * psi


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        if self.downsample:
            identity = self.downsample(identity)
        out += identity
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)

        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.att3 = AttentionGate(256, 256, 128)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)

        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.att2 = AttentionGate(128, 128, 64)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)

        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.att1 = AttentionGate(64, 64, 32)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))

        up3 = self.up3(b)
        att3 = self.att3(up3, e3)
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([up3, att3], 1))

        up2 = self.up2(d3)
        att2 = self.att2(up2, e2)
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([up2, att2], 1))

        up1 = self.up1(d2)
        att1 = self.att1(up1, e1)
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([up1, att1], 1))

        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, transform=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir

            clean = self.transform(clean_img)
        else:

            clean = transforms.ToTensor()(clean_img)
        return noisy, clean

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.shortcut = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else nn.Identity()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(
            256, 128, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1
        )
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(
            128, 64, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1
        )
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(enc1))
        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(enc2))

        dec = self.upconv1(bottleneck)
        # Dynamic cropping for encoder features
        _, _, h, w = dec.shape
        enc2 = enc2[:, :, :h, :w]
        dec = torch.cat([dec, enc2], dim=1)
        dec = self.dec1(dec)

        dec = self.upconv2(dec)
        _, _, h, w = dec.shape
        enc1 = enc1[:, :, :h, :w]
        dec = torch.cat([dec, enc1], dim=1)
        dec = self.dec2(dec)

        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(dec))

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
from torchvision import transforms
from torchvision.transforms import (
    RandomHorizontalFlip,
    RandomVerticalFlip,
    RandomRotation,
    RandomCrop,
    CenterCrop,
    GaussianBlur,
)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, transform=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.filenames = [f for f in os.listdir(noisy_dir) if f.endswith(".png")]

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy_path = os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.filenames[idx])
        clean_path = os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.filenames[idx])

        noisy_img = Image.open(noisy_path).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(clean_path).convert("L")

        if self.transform:
            seed = torch.randint(0, 2**32, ())
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy_img = self.transform(noisy_img)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            clean_img = self.transform(clean_img)

        noisy_tensor = transforms.ToTensor()(noisy_img)
        clean_tensor = transforms.ToTensor()(clean_img)
        residual = noisy_tensor - clean_tensor
        return noisy_tensor, residual


class DnCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        layers = [nn.Conv2d(1, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(inplace=True)]
        for _ in range(15):
            layers += [
                nn.Conv2d(64, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            ]
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(64, 1, kernel_size=3, padding=1))
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


def main():
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    batch_size = 16
    num_epochs = 50
    crop_size = 256

    if os.path.exists("best_model.pth"):
        os.remove("best_model.pth")

    transform_train = transforms.Compose(
        [
            RandomHorizontalFlip(),
            RandomVerticalFlip(),
            RandomRotation(10),
            RandomCrop(crop_size),
            GaussianBlur(kernel_size=3, sigma=(0.1, 0.5)),
        ]
    )

    transform_val = transforms.Compose([CenterCrop(crop_size)])

    full_dataset = DenoisingDataset(
        noisy_dir="input/train",
        clean_dir="input/train_cleaned",
        transform=transform_train,
    )

    train_size = int(0.8 * len(full_dataset))
    val_size = len(full_dataset) - train_size
    train_dataset, val_dataset = random_split(full_dataset, [train_size, val_size])
    val_dataset.dataset.transform = transform_val

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4
    )

    model = DnCNN().to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
        optimizer, mode="min", factor=0.5, patience=3, verbose=True
    )
    criterion = nn.MSELoss()

    best_rmse = float("inf")
    for epoch in range(num_epochs):
        model.train()
        train_loss = 0.0
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            train_loss += loss.item() * inputs.size(0)
        train_loss /= len(train_loader.dataset)

        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for inputs, targets in val_loader:
                inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
                outputs = model(inputs)
                val_loss += criterion(outputs, targets).item() * inputs.size(0)
        val_loss /= len(val_loader.dataset)
        val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss)
        scheduler.step(val_rmse)
        print(
            f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {train_loss:.5f} | Val RMSE: {val_rmse:.5f}"
        )
        if val_rmse < best_rmse:
            best_rmse = val_rmse
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

    print(f"Best Validation RMSE: {best_rmse:.5f}")

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
    model.eval()

    submission = []
    test_dir = "input/test"
    transform = transforms.ToTensor()
    for filename in os.listdir(test_dir):
        if not filename.endswith(".png"):
            continue
        img_path = os.path.join(test_dir, filename)
        img = Image.open(img_path).convert("L")
        img_tensor = transform(img).unsqueeze(0).to(device)

        with torch.no_grad():
            residual = model(img_tensor)
        denoised = torch.clamp(img_tensor - residual, 0, 1).squeeze().cpu().numpy()

        h, w = denoised.shape
        image_id = os.path.splitext(filename)[0]
        rows, cols = np.indices((h, w))
        pixel_ids = [
            f"{image_id}_{r+1}_{c+1}" for r, c in zip(rows.ravel(), cols.ravel())
        ]
        values = denoised.ravel()

        submission.extend(zip(pixel_ids, values))

    df = pd.DataFrame(submission, columns=["id", "value"])
    os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
    df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

            nn.Conv2d(F_g + F_l, F_int, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )
        self.channel_attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, F_int // 16, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(F_int // 16, F_int, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.spatial_attention = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, 1), nn.Sigmoid())
        self.conv_out = nn.Conv2d(F_int, F_l, 1)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        combined = torch.cat([g, x], dim=1)
        combined = self.combine(combined)
        ca = self.channel_attention(combined) * combined
        sa = self.spatial_attention(combined) * combined
        out = self.conv_out(ca + sa)
        return x * out


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        if self.downsample:
            identity = self.downsample(identity)
        out += identity
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)

        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.att3 = SCSEWithGate(256, 256, 128)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)

        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.att2 = SCSEWithGate(128, 128, 64)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)

        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.att1 = SCSEWithGate(64, 64, 32)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))

        up3 = self.up3(b)
        att3 = self.att3(up3, e3)
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([up3, att3], 1))

        up2 = self.up2(d3)
        att2 = self.att2(up2, e2)
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([up2, att2], 1))

        up1 = self.up1(d2)
        att1 = self.att1(up1, e1)
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([up1, att1], 1))

        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.shortcut = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else nn.Identity()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(
            256, 128, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1
        )
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(
            128, 64, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1
        )
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(enc1))
        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(enc2))

        dec = self.upconv1(bottleneck)
        _, _, h, w = dec.shape
        enc2 = enc2[:, :, :h, :w]
        dec = torch.cat([dec, enc2], dim=1)
        dec = self.dec1(dec)

        dec = self.upconv2(dec)
        _, _, h, w = dec.shape
        enc1 = enc1[:, :, :h, :w]
        dec = torch.cat([dec, enc1], dim=1)
        dec = self.dec2(dec)

        return torch.sigmoid(self.final(dec))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, crop_size=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.crop_size = crop_size
        self.transform = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomCrop(crop_size),
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                    transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(),
                ]
            )
            if crop_size
            else None
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename)).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename)).convert("L")

        if self.transform:
            seed = torch.randint(0, 1000000, (1,)).item()
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy_img = self.transform(noisy_img)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            clean_img = self.transform(clean_img)
            noisy = torch.tensor(
                np.array(noisy_img) / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32
            ).unsqueeze(0)
            clean = torch.tensor(
                np.array(clean_img) / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32
            ).unsqueeze(0)
            return noisy, clean
        else:
            original_H = noisy_img.height
            original_W = noisy_img.width
            pad_h = (4 - (original_H % 4)) % 4
            pad_w = (4 - (original_W % 4)) % 4
            padder = transforms.Pad((0, 0, pad_w, pad_h), padding_mode="reflect")
            padded_noisy = padder(noisy_img)
            noisy_tensor = torch.tensor(
                np.array(padded_noisy) / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32
            ).unsqueeze(0)
            clean_tensor = torch.tensor(
                np.array(clean_img) / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32
            ).unsqueeze(0)
            return noisy_tensor, clean_tensor, (original_H, original_W)

class SCSEWithGate(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, F_g, F_l, F_int):
        super().__init__()
        self.combine = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_g + F_l, F_int, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )
        self.channel_attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, F_int // 16, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(F_int // 16, F_int, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.spatial_attention = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, 1), nn.Sigmoid())
        self.conv_out = nn.Conv2d(F_int, F_l, 1)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        combined = torch.cat([g, x], dim=1)
        combined = self.combine(combined)
        ca = self.channel_attention(combined) * combined
        sa = self.spatial_attention(combined) * combined
        out = self.conv_out(ca + sa)
        return x * out


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)

        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        if self.downsample:
            identity = self.downsample(identity)
        out += identity
        return self.relu(out)

        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)

        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)

        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.att3 = SCSEWithGate(256, 256, 128)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)

        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.att2 = SCSEWithGate(128, 128, 64)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)

        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.att1 = SCSEWithGate(64, 64, 32)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))

        up1 = self.up1(d2)
        att1 = self.att1(up1, e1)
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([up1, att1], 1))

from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
from torchvision import transforms
from torchvision.transforms import (
    RandomHorizontalFlip,
    RandomVerticalFlip,
    RandomRotation,
    RandomCrop,
    CenterCrop,
    GaussianBlur,
)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, transform=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.filenames = sorted(
            [f for f in os.listdir(noisy_dir) if f.endswith(".png")]
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy_path = os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.filenames[idx])
        clean_path = os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.filenames[idx])

        noisy_img = Image.open(noisy_path).convert("L")
        clean_img = Image.open(clean_path).convert("L")

        if self.transform:
            seed = torch.randint(0, 2**32, ())
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy_img = self.transform(noisy_img)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            clean_img = self.transform(clean_img)

        noisy_tensor = transforms.ToTensor()(noisy_img)
        clean_tensor = transforms.ToTensor()(clean_img)
        residual = noisy_tensor - clean_tensor
        return noisy_tensor, residual


class DnCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        layers = [nn.Conv2d(1, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(inplace=True)]
        for _ in range(15):
            layers += [
                nn.Conv2d(64, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            ]
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(64, 1, kernel_size=3, padding=1))
        self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


def main():
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    batch_size = 16
    num_epochs = 50
    crop_size = 256

    if os.path.exists("best_model.pth"):
        os.remove("best_model.pth")

    transform_train = transforms.Compose(
        [
            RandomHorizontalFlip(),
            RandomVerticalFlip(),
            RandomRotation(10),
            RandomCrop(crop_size),
            GaussianBlur(kernel_size=3, sigma=(0.1, 0.5)),
        ]
    )

    transform_val = transforms.Compose([CenterCrop(crop_size)])

    full_dataset = DenoisingDataset(
        noisy_dir="input/train",
        clean_dir="input/train_cleaned",
        transform=transform_train,
    )

    train_size = int(0.8 * len(full_dataset))
    val_size = len(full_dataset) - train_size
    train_dataset, val_dataset = random_split(full_dataset, [train_size, val_size])
    val_dataset.dataset.transform = transform_val

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4
    )

    model = DnCNN().to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
        optimizer, mode="min", factor=0.5, patience=3, verbose=True
    )
    criterion = nn.MSELoss()

    best_rmse = float("inf")
    for epoch in range(num_epochs):
        model.train()
        train_loss = 0.0
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            train_loss += loss.item() * inputs.size(0)
        train_loss /= len(train_loader.dataset)

        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0.0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for inputs, targets in val_loader:
                inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
                outputs = model(inputs)
                val_loss += criterion(outputs, targets).item() * inputs.size(0)
        val_loss /= len(val_loader.dataset)
        val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss)
        scheduler.step(val_rmse)
        print(
            f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {train_loss:.5f} | Val RMSE: {val_rmse:.5f}"
        )
        if val_rmse < best_rmse:
            best_rmse = val_rmse
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

    print(f"Best Validation RMSE: {best_rmse:.5f}")

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
    model.eval()

    submission = []
    test_dir = "input/test"
    transform = transforms.ToTensor()
    test_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(test_dir) if f.endswith(".png")])

    for img_idx, filename in enumerate(test_files, start=1):
        img_path = os.path.join(test_dir, filename)
        img = Image.open(img_path).convert("L")
        img_tensor = transform(img).unsqueeze(0).to(device)

        with torch.no_grad():
            residual = model(img_tensor)
        denoised = torch.clamp(img_tensor - residual, 0, 1).squeeze().cpu().numpy()

        h, w = denoised.shape
        rows, cols = np.indices((h, w))
        pixel_ids = [
            f"{img_idx}_{r+1}_{c+1}" for r, c in zip(rows.ravel(), cols.ravel())
        ]
        values = denoised.ravel()

        submission.extend(zip(pixel_ids, values))

    df = pd.DataFrame(submission, columns=["id", "value"])
    os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
    df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
