TARGET_SIZE = (540, 420)
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class SeparableConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, padding=0):
        super().__init__()
        self.depthwise = nn.Conv2d(
            in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size, padding=padding, groups=in_channels
        )
        self.pointwise = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.pointwise(self.depthwise(x))


class ChannelAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, reduction_ratio=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.max_pool = nn.AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_channels, in_channels // reduction_ratio),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(in_channels // reduction_ratio, in_channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = self.fc(self.avg_pool(x).view(x.size(0), -1))
        max_out = self.fc(self.max_pool(x).view(x.size(0), -1))
        return x * (avg_out + max_out).view(x.size(0), x.size(1), 1, 1)


class SpatialAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(2, 1, 7, padding=3)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        max_out, _ = torch.max(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        return x * self.sigmoid(self.conv(torch.cat([avg_out, max_out], dim=1)))


class CBAM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.channel_att = ChannelAttention(in_channels)
        self.spatial_att = SpatialAttention()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.channel_att(x)
        return self.spatial_att(x)


class DenoiseNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(64), nn.ReLU()
        )
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(128), nn.ReLU()
        )
        self.enc3 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(256), nn.ReLU()
        )
        self.attention = CBAM(256)

        # Decoder with skip connections
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(256 + 128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(128 + 64, 64, 3, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(64), nn.ReLU()
        )
        self.final_conv = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(64, 1, 3, padding=1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)  # 64 channels
        e2 = self.enc2(e1)  # 128 channels
        e3 = self.enc3(e2)  # 256 channels
        att = self.attention(e3)

        # Decoder with skip connections
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([att, e2], 1))  # 256+128=384 -> 128
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([d1, e1], 1))  # 128+64=192 -> 64
        return self.final_conv(d2)


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = torch.ones(window_size, window_size) / window_size**2
        self.window = self.window.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(device)

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        mu1 = F.conv2d(y_pred, self.window, padding=5)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(y_true, self.window, padding=5)
        mu1_sq, mu2_sq, mu12 = mu1.pow(2), mu2.pow(2), mu1 * mu2

        sigma1_sq = F.conv2d(y_pred * y_pred, self.window, padding=5) - mu1_sq
        sigma2_sq = F.conv2d(y_true * y_true, self.window, padding=5) - mu2_sq
        sigma12 = F.conv2d(y_pred * y_true, self.window, padding=5) - mu12

        C1, C2 = 0.01**2, 0.03**2
        ssim = ((2 * mu12 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim.mean()


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir

        noisy = enhancer.enhance(random.uniform(0.9, 1.1))

        # Resize and convert to tensor
        noisy = np.array(noisy.resize(TARGET_SIZE), dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean.resize(TARGET_SIZE), dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        return torch.tensor(noisy).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(clean).unsqueeze(0)

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, groups=in_channels),
            nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.conv2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, groups=out_channels),
            nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
        )
        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels // 16, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(out_channels // 16, out_channels, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = out * self.attention(out)
        if self.downsample:
            residual = self.downsample(residual)
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)

        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(256 + 128, 128)
        self.up2 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(128 + 64, 64)
        self.final_conv = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 3, padding=1), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)  # 64
        p1 = self.pool1(e1)
        e2 = self.enc2(p1)  # 128
        p2 = self.pool2(e2)
        e3 = self.enc3(p2)  # 256

        # Decoder
        d1 = self.up1(e3)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e2], 1)

        d2 = self.up2(d1)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e1], 1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)  # 64
        return self.final_conv(d2)

        self.crop_size = 256  # Always use 256 for both train and validation

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        file = self.files[idx]
        input_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.input_dir, file)).convert("L")
        target_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.target_dir, file)).convert("L")

        # Apply cropping based on mode
        if self.crop_size is not None:
            if self.train:
                i, j, h, w = transforms.RandomCrop.get_params(
                    input_img, output_size=(self.crop_size, self.crop_size)
                )
                input_img = F.crop(input_img, i, j, h, w)
                target_img = F.crop(target_img, i, j, h, w)
            else:
                # Center crop for validation
                i = (input_img.height - self.crop_size) // 2
                j = (input_img.width - self.crop_size) // 2
                input_img = F.crop(input_img, i, j, self.crop_size, self.crop_size)
                target_img = F.crop(target_img, i, j, self.crop_size, self.crop_size)

        if self.train and random.random() > 0.5:
            angle = random.choice([90, 180, 270])
            input_img = F.rotate(input_img, angle)
            target_img = F.rotate(target_img, angle)

        input_tensor = transforms.ToTensor()(input_img)
        target_tensor = transforms.ToTensor()(target_img)
        return input_tensor, target_tensor


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),

            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(64, 64, 2, stride=2),
        )
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.enc1(x)
        x2 = self.enc2(x1)
        x = self.dec1(x2)
        return self.final(x)

import os

from torchvision import transforms, models
import torch.nn.functional as F


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.sigma = sigma
        self.channel = 1
        self.window = self.create_window()

    def gaussian(self, window_size, sigma):
        x = torch.arange(window_size) - window_size // 2
        g = torch.exp(-0.5 * (x / sigma) ** 2)
        g = g.ger(g)
        return g / g.sum()

    def create_window(self):
        window = self.gaussian(self.window_size, self.sigma)
        return window.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        window = self.window.to(y_pred.device)
        mu_pred = F.conv2d(
            y_pred, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=self.channel
        )
        mu_true = F.conv2d(
            y_true, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=self.channel
        )

        mu_pred_sq = mu_pred.pow(2)
        mu_true_sq = mu_true.pow(2)
        mu_pred_mu_true = mu_pred * mu_true

        sigma_pred_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_pred * y_pred,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_pred_sq
        )
        sigma_true_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_true * y_true,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_true_sq
        )
        sigma_pred_true = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_pred * y_true,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_pred_mu_true
        )

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2
        ssim = ((2 * mu_pred_mu_true + C1) * (2 * sigma_pred_true + C2)) / (
            (mu_pred_sq + mu_true_sq + C1) * (sigma_pred_sq + sigma_true_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim.mean()


class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, F_g, F_l, F_int):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(F_g, F_int, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int))
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(F_l, F_int, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int))
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return x * psi


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

        def conv_block(in_c, out_c):
            return nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
                nn.Conv2d(out_c, out_c, 3, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_c),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            )

        self.enc1 = conv_block(1, 64)
        self.enc2 = conv_block(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = conv_block(128, 256)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = conv_block(256, 512)

        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn3 = AttentionBlock(256, 256, 128)
        self.dec3 = conv_block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn2 = AttentionBlock(128, 128, 64)
        self.dec2 = conv_block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn1 = AttentionBlock(64, 64, 32)
        self.dec1 = conv_block(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool(e2))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool(e3))

        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(b), self.attn3(self.up3(b), e3)], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), self.attn2(self.up2(d3), e2)], 1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), self.attn1(self.up1(d2), e1)], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))


class VGGPerceptualLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        vgg = models.vgg16(pretrained=True).features[:16].eval()
        for param in vgg.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        self.vgg = vgg
        self.mse = nn.MSELoss()

    def forward(self, output, target):
        output_rgb = output.repeat(1, 3, 1, 1)
        target_rgb = target.repeat(1, 3, 1, 1)
        mean = torch.tensor([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], device=output.device).view(
            1, 3, 1, 1
        )
        std = torch.tensor([0.229, 0.224, 0.225], device=output.device).view(1, 3, 1, 1)
        output_rgb = (output_rgb - mean) / std
        target_rgb = (target_rgb - mean) / std
        return self.mse(self.vgg(output_rgb), self.vgg(target_rgb))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, transform=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.filenames = [f for f in os.listdir(noisy_dir) if f.endswith(".png")]

    def __len__(self):

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.filenames[idx])).convert(
            "L"
        )
        clean = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.filenames[idx])).convert(
            "L"
        )
        if self.transform:
            seed = np.random.randint(2147483647)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy = self.transform(noisy)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            clean = self.transform(clean)
        else:
            noisy = transforms.ToTensor()(noisy)
            clean = transforms.ToTensor()(clean)
        return noisy, clean

TARGET_SIZE = (540, 420)
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, in_channels, 3, padding=1, groups=in_channels),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.conv2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, groups=out_channels),
            nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
        )
        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels // 16, 1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(out_channels // 16, out_channels, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = out * self.attention(out)
        if self.downsample:
            residual = self.downsample(residual)
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class DenoiseNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)

        # Decoder
        self.up1 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(256 + 128, 128)
        self.up2 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(128 + 64, 64)
        self.final_conv = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 3, padding=1), nn.Sigmoid())

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        p1 = self.pool1(e1)
        e2 = self.enc2(p1)
        p2 = self.pool2(e2)
        e3 = self.enc3(p2)

        # Decoder
        d1 = self.up1(e3)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e2], 1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)
        d2 = self.up2(d1)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e1], 1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)
        return self.final_conv(d2)


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = torch.ones(window_size, window_size) / window_size**2
        self.window = self.window.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(device)

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        mu1 = F.conv2d(y_pred, self.window, padding=5)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(y_true, self.window, padding=5)
        mu1_sq, mu2_sq, mu12 = mu1.pow(2), mu2.pow(2), mu1 * mu2

        sigma1_sq = F.conv2d(y_pred * y_pred, self.window, padding=5) - mu1_sq
        sigma2_sq = F.conv2d(y_true * y_true, self.window, padding=5) - mu2_sq
        sigma12 = F.conv2d(y_pred * y_true, self.window, padding=5) - mu12

        C1, C2 = 0.01**2, 0.03**2
        ssim = ((2 * mu12 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim.mean()


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename)).convert("L")
        clean = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename)).convert("L")

        angle = random.uniform(-5, 5)
        noisy = noisy.rotate(angle)
        clean = clean.rotate(angle)

        if random.random() > 0.5:
            noisy = noisy.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
            clean = clean.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)

        enhancer = ImageEnhance.Brightness(noisy)
        noisy = enhancer.enhance(random.uniform(0.9, 1.1))
        enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(noisy)
        noisy = enhancer.enhance(random.uniform(0.9, 1.1))

        noisy = np.array(noisy.resize(TARGET_SIZE), dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean.resize(TARGET_SIZE), dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        return torch.tensor(noisy).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(clean).unsqueeze(0)

class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):

        self.filenames = filenames

    def __len__(self):

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_img = (

            .convert("L")

        clean_img = (

            torch.tensor(np.array(clean_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0).unsqueeze(0),
        )


class ChannelAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.max_pool = nn.AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels // reduction, 1, bias=False),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(channels // reduction, channels, 1, bias=False),
        )
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = self.fc(self.avg_pool(x))
        max_out = self.fc(self.max_pool(x))
        return self.sigmoid(avg_out + max_out)


class SpatialAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(2, 1, 7, padding=3, bias=False)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        max_out, _ = torch.max(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        x = torch.cat([avg_out, max_out], dim=1)
        return self.sigmoid(self.conv(x))


class AttnResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
        )
        self.ca = ChannelAttention(channels)
        self.sa = SpatialAttention()
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.ca(x) * x  # Channel attention
        x = self.sa(x) * x  # Spatial attention
        x += residual
        return self.relu(x)


class DeepResCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_blocks=12):
        super().__init__()
        self.initial = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(64), nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        )
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[AttnResBlock(64) for _ in range(num_blocks)])
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 3, padding=1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.initial(x)
        x = self.blocks(x)
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(x))

class DnCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers=17, num_features=64):
        super(DnCNN, self).__init__()
        layers = [
            nn.Conv2d(1, num_features, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        ]
        for _ in range(num_layers - 2):
            layers += [
                nn.Conv2d(num_features, num_features, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            ]
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(num_features, 1, 3, padding=1, bias=False))
        self.dncnn = nn.Sequential(*layers)

        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Conv2d):
                nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, mode="fan_out", nonlinearity="relu")
            elif isinstance(m, nn.BatchNorm2d):
                nn.init.constant_(m.weight, 1)
                nn.init.constant_(m.bias, 0)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.dncnn(x)

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
from torchvision import transforms, models
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, F_g, F_l, F_int):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(F_g, F_int, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int))
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(F_l, F_int, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int))
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return x * psi


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)

        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn3 = AttentionBlock(256, 256, 128)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn2 = AttentionBlock(128, 128, 64)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn1 = AttentionBlock(64, 64, 32)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool(e2))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool(e3))

        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(b), self.attn3(self.up3(b), e3)], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), self.attn2(self.up2(d3), e2)], 1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), self.attn1(self.up1(d2), e1)], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.sigma = sigma
        self.channel = 1
        self.window = self.create_window()

    def gaussian(self, window_size, sigma):
        x = torch.arange(window_size) - window_size // 2
        g = torch.exp(-0.5 * (x / sigma) ** 2)
        g = g.ger(g)
        return g / g.sum()

    def create_window(self):
        window = self.gaussian(self.window_size, self.sigma)
        return window.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        window = self.window.to(y_pred.device)
        mu_pred = F.conv2d(
            y_pred, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=self.channel
        )
        mu_true = F.conv2d(
            y_true, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=self.channel
        )
        mu_pred_sq = mu_pred.pow(2)
        mu_true_sq = mu_true.pow(2)
        mu_pred_mu_true = mu_pred * mu_true

        sigma_pred_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_pred * y_pred,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_pred_sq
        )
        sigma_true_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_true * y_true,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_true_sq
        )
        sigma_pred_true = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_pred * y_true,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_pred_mu_true
        )

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2
        ssim = ((2 * mu_pred_mu_true + C1) * (2 * sigma_pred_true + C2)) / (
            (mu_pred_sq + mu_true_sq + C1) * (sigma_pred_sq + sigma_true_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim.mean()


class VGGPerceptualLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        vgg = models.vgg16(pretrained=True).features[:16].eval()
        for param in vgg.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        self.vgg = vgg
        self.mse = nn.MSELoss()

    def forward(self, output, target):
        output_rgb = output.repeat(1, 3, 1, 1)
        target_rgb = target.repeat(1, 3, 1, 1)
        mean = torch.tensor([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], device=output.device).view(
            1, 3, 1, 1
        )
        std = torch.tensor([0.229, 0.224, 0.225], device=output.device).view(1, 3, 1, 1)
        output_rgb = (output_rgb - mean) / std
        target_rgb = (target_rgb - mean) / std
        return self.mse(self.vgg(output_rgb), self.vgg(target_rgb))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, transform=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.filenames = [f for f in os.listdir(noisy_dir) if f.endswith(".png")]

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.filenames[idx])).convert(
            "L"
        )
        clean = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.filenames[idx])).convert(
            "L"
        )
        if self.transform:
            seed = np.random.randint(2147483647)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy = self.transform(noisy)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            clean = self.transform(clean)
        else:
            noisy = transforms.ToTensor()(noisy)
            clean = transforms.ToTensor()(clean)
        return noisy, clean


train_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.RandomCrop(256),
        transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomRotation(10),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
    ]
)

dataset = DenoisingDataset("input/train", "input/train_cleaned", train_transform)

val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=8, num_workers=4)

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = UNet().to(device)
criterion_mse = nn.MSELoss()
criterion_vgg = VGGPerceptualLoss().to(device)
criterion_ssim = SSIMLoss().to(device)
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    optimizer, "min", patience=3, factor=0.5

best_rmse = float("inf")
for epoch in range(100):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0.0
    for inputs, targets in train_loader:
        inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)

        train_loss += loss.item() * inputs.size(0)
    train_loss /= len(train_loader.dataset)

    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0.0

        for inputs, targets in val_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)

    val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss / len(val_loader.dataset))

class DnCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers=17, num_features=64):
        super(DnCNN, self).__init__()
        layers = [
            nn.Conv2d(1, num_features, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        ]
        for _ in range(num_layers - 2):
            layers += [
                nn.Conv2d(num_features, num_features, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            ]
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(num_features, 1, 3, padding=1, bias=False))
        self.dncnn = nn.Sequential(*layers)

        for m in self.modules():
            if isinstance(m, nn.Conv2d):
                nn.init.kaiming_normal_(m.weight, mode="fan_out", nonlinearity="relu")
            elif isinstance(m, nn.BatchNorm2d):
                nn.init.constant_(m.weight, 1)
                nn.init.constant_(m.bias, 0)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.dncnn(x)

        clean = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.files[idx])).convert("L")
        return self.transform(noisy), self.transform(clean)

import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import pandas as pd
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler

TARGET_SIZE = (540, 420)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_img = (
            Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename))
            .convert("L")
            .resize(TARGET_SIZE)
        )
        clean_img = (
            Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename))
            .convert("L")
            .resize(TARGET_SIZE)
        )
        return (
            torch.tensor(np.array(noisy_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0).unsqueeze(0),
            torch.tensor(np.array(clean_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0).unsqueeze(0),
        )


class ChannelAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.max_pool = nn.AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels // reduction, 1, bias=False),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(channels // reduction, channels, 1, bias=False),
        )
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = self.fc(self.avg_pool(x))
        max_out = self.fc(self.max_pool(x))
        return self.sigmoid(avg_out + max_out)


class SpatialAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(2, 1, 7, padding=3, bias=False)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        max_out, _ = torch.max(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        x = torch.cat([avg_out, max_out], dim=1)
        return self.sigmoid(self.conv(x))


class AttnResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
        )
        self.ca = ChannelAttention(channels)
        self.sa = SpatialAttention()
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = self.ca(x) * x
        x = self.sa(x) * x
        x += residual
        return self.relu(x)


class DeepResCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_blocks=8):  # Reduced from 12 to 8
        super().__init__()
        self.initial = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1), nn.BatchNorm2d(64), nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        )
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[AttnResBlock(64) for _ in range(num_blocks)])
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 3, padding=1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.initial(x)
        x = self.blocks(x)
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(x))


# Data setup
train_dir = "input/train"
clean_dir = "input/train_cleaned"
all_files = os.listdir(train_dir)
train_files, val_files = np.split(
    np.random.permutation(all_files), [int(0.85 * len(all_files))]
)

batch_size = 8  # Reduced from 16 to 8
train_dataset = DenoisingDataset(train_dir, clean_dir, train_files)
val_dataset = DenoisingDataset(train_dir, clean_dir, val_files)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True
)

# Model config
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = DeepResCNN().to(device)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-4, weight_decay=1e-5)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    optimizer, "min", factor=0.5, patience=3
)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()
scaler = GradScaler()

# Training loop
best_rmse = float("inf")
for epoch in range(40):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0.0
    for inputs, targets in train_loader:
        inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()

        with autocast():
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()

        train_loss += loss.item() * inputs.size(0)
    train_loss /= len(train_dataset)

    # Validation
    val_loss = 0.0
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        for inputs, targets in val_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            outputs = model(inputs)
            val_loss += criterion(outputs, targets).item() * inputs.size(0)
    val_loss /= len(val_dataset)
    current_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss)
    scheduler.step(val_loss)

    if current_rmse < best_rmse:
        best_rmse = current_rmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), os.path.join("working", "best_model.pth"))

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Train Loss: {train_loss:.5f}, Val RMSE: {current_rmse:.5f}"
    )

# Generate submission
model.load_state_dict(torch.load(os.path.join("working", "best_model.pth")))
model.eval()
predictions = []
test_dir = "input/test"
for filename in os.listdir(test_dir):
    img = Image.open(os.path.join(test_dir, filename)).convert("L")
    original_size = img.size
    img_resized = img.resize(TARGET_SIZE)
    img_tensor = (
        torch.tensor(np.array(img_resized, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0)
        .unsqueeze(0)
        .unsqueeze(0)
        .to(device)
    )

    with torch.no_grad(), autocast():
        output = model(img_tensor).squeeze().cpu().numpy()

    output_pil = Image.fromarray((output * 255).astype(np.uint8)).resize(original_size)
    output_arr = np.array(output_pil, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0

    image_id = os.path.splitext(filename)[0]
    rows, cols = output_arr.shape
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            predictions.append((f"{image_id}_{r+1}_{c+1}", output_arr[r, c]))

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(predictions, columns=["id", "value"])
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Best Validation RMSE: {best_rmse:.5f}")
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
from torchvision import transforms, models
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, F_g, F_l, F_int):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(F_g, F_int, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int))
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(F_l, F_int, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int))
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return x * psi


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)

        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn3 = AttentionBlock(256, 256, 128)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn2 = AttentionBlock(128, 128, 64)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn1 = AttentionBlock(64, 64, 32)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool(e2))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool(e3))

        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(b), self.attn3(self.up3(b), e3)], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), self.attn2(self.up2(d3), e2)], 1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), self.attn1(self.up1(d2), e1)], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.sigma = sigma
        self.channel = 1
        self.window = self.create_window()

    def gaussian(self, window_size, sigma):
        x = torch.arange(window_size) - window_size // 2
        g = torch.exp(-0.5 * (x / sigma) ** 2)
        g = g.ger(g)
        return g / g.sum()

    def create_window(self):
        window = self.gaussian(self.window_size, self.sigma)
        return window.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        window = self.window.to(y_pred.device)
        mu_pred = F.conv2d(
            y_pred, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=self.channel
        )
        mu_true = F.conv2d(
            y_true, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=self.channel
        )
        mu_pred_sq = mu_pred.pow(2)
        mu_true_sq = mu_true.pow(2)
        mu_pred_mu_true = mu_pred * mu_true

        sigma_pred_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_pred * y_pred,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_pred_sq
        )
        sigma_true_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_true * y_true,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_true_sq
        )
        sigma_pred_true = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_pred * y_true,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_pred_mu_true
        )

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2
        ssim = ((2 * mu_pred_mu_true + C1) * (2 * sigma_pred_true + C2)) / (
            (mu_pred_sq + mu_true_sq + C1) * (sigma_pred_sq + sigma_true_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim.mean()


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, transform=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.filenames = [f for f in os.listdir(noisy_dir) if f.endswith(".png")]

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.filenames[idx])).convert(
            "L"
        )
        clean = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.filenames[idx])).convert(
            "L"
        )
        if self.transform:
            seed = np.random.randint(2147483647)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy = self.transform(noisy)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            clean = self.transform(clean)
        else:
            noisy = transforms.ToTensor()(noisy)
            clean = transforms.ToTensor()(clean)
        return noisy, clean


train_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.RandomCrop(256),
        transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomRotation(10),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
    ]
)

dataset = DenoisingDataset("input/train", "input/train_cleaned", train_transform)
train_ds, val_ds = random_split(
    dataset, [int(0.8 * len(dataset)), len(dataset) - int(0.8 * len(dataset))]
)
train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=8, shuffle=True, num_workers=4)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=8, num_workers=4)

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = UNet().to(device)
criterion_mse = nn.MSELoss()
criterion_ssim = SSIMLoss().to(device)
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    optimizer, "min", patience=3, factor=0.5
)

best_rmse = float("inf")
for epoch in range(100):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0.0
    for inputs, targets in train_loader:
        inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(inputs)
        mse_loss = criterion_mse(outputs, targets)
        ssim_loss = criterion_ssim(outputs, targets)
        loss = mse_loss + 1.0 * ssim_loss  # Increased SSIM weight
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += loss.item() * inputs.size(0)
    train_loss /= len(train_loader.dataset)

    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0.0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for inputs, targets in val_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            outputs = model(inputs)
            val_loss += criterion_mse(outputs, targets).item() * inputs.size(0)
    val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss / len(val_loader.dataset))
    scheduler.step(val_rmse)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Train Loss: {train_loss:.4f}, Val RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

    if val_rmse < best_rmse:
        best_rmse = val_rmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

print(f"Best Validation RMSE: {best_rmse:.4f}")

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
model.eval()
submission = []
for filename in os.listdir("input/test"):
    if filename.endswith(".png"):
        img = Image.open(f"input/test/{filename}").convert("L")
        W, H = img.size
        pad_w = (8 - W % 8) % 8
        pad_h = (8 - H % 8) % 8
        img = transforms.functional.pad(
            img,
            (pad_w // 2, pad_h // 2, pad_w - pad_w // 2, pad_h - pad_h // 2),
            padding_mode="reflect",
        )
        tensor = transforms.ToTensor()(img).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            pred = model(tensor).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
        pred = pred[pad_h // 2 : pad_h // 2 + H, pad_w // 2 : pad_w // 2 + W]
        img_id = filename.split(".")[0]
        submission.extend(
            [
                [f"{img_id}_{i+1}_{j+1}", pred[i, j]]
                for i in range(pred.shape[0])
                for j in range(pred.shape[1])
            ]
        )

pd.DataFrame(submission, columns=["id", "value"]).to_csv(
    "submission/submission.csv", index=False
)
import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import torchvision.transforms as transforms

# Ensure working directory exists
os.makedirs("./working", exist_ok=True)
model_path = "./working/best_model.pth"


class DnCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_layers=17, num_features=64):
        super(DnCNN, self).__init__()
        layers = [
            nn.Conv2d(1, num_features, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        ]
        for _ in range(num_layers - 2):
            layers += [
                nn.Conv2d(num_features, num_features, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features),
                nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            ]
        layers.append(nn.Conv2d(num_features, 1, 3, padding=1, bias=False))
        self.dncnn = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.dncnn(x)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, files, transform=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.files = files
        self.transform = transform or transforms.ToTensor()

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.files)

import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
from torchvision.transforms.functional import to_tensor
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

TARGET_SIZE = (540, 420)
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class DenoiseNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Decoder with skip connections
        self.up1 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128 + 128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        self.up2 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128 + 64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        p1 = self.pool1(e1)
        e2 = self.enc2(p1)
        p2 = self.pool2(e2)

        # Decoder with skip connections
        u1 = self.up1(p2)
        c1 = torch.cat([u1, e2], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(c1)

        u2 = self.up2(d1)
        c2 = torch.cat([u2, e1], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(c2)

        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d2))


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = torch.ones(window_size, window_size) / window_size**2
        self.window = self.window.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(device)

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        mu_pred = F.conv2d(y_pred, self.window, padding=5)
        mu_true = F.conv2d(y_true, self.window, padding=5)
        mu_pred_sq = mu_pred**2
        mu_true_sq = mu_true**2
        mu_pred_true = mu_pred * mu_true

        sigma_pred_sq = F.conv2d(y_pred**2, self.window, padding=5) - mu_pred_sq
        sigma_true_sq = F.conv2d(y_true**2, self.window, padding=5) - mu_true_sq
        sigma_pred_true = (
            F.conv2d(y_pred * y_true, self.window, padding=5) - mu_pred_true
        )

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2
        ssim = ((2 * mu_pred_true + C1) * (2 * sigma_pred_true + C2)) / (
            (mu_pred_sq + mu_true_sq + C1) * (sigma_pred_sq + sigma_true_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim.mean()


class DocumentDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir):
        self.noisy_files = sorted(Path(noisy_dir).glob("*.png"))
        self.clean_files = sorted(Path(clean_dir).glob("*.png"))

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy_files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy = Image.open(self.noisy_files[idx]).resize(TARGET_SIZE)
        clean = Image.open(self.clean_files[idx]).resize(TARGET_SIZE)
        return to_tensor(noisy), to_tensor(clean)


# Data preparation
full_dataset = DocumentDataset("input/train", "input/train_cleaned")
train_size = int(0.9 * len(full_dataset))
val_size = len(full_dataset) - train_size
train_dataset, val_dataset = random_split(full_dataset, [train_size, val_size])

train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=8, shuffle=True, num_workers=4)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=8, shuffle=False, num_workers=4)

# Model setup
model = DenoiseNet().to(device)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    optimizer, "min", patience=3, factor=0.5
)
mse_loss = nn.MSELoss()
ssim = SSIMLoss().to(device)


class GradientLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        sobel_x = torch.tensor(
            [[[[1, 0, -1], [2, 0, -2], [1, 0, -1]]]], dtype=torch.float32
        )
        sobel_y = torch.tensor(
            [[[[1, 2, 1], [0, 0, 0], [-1, -2, -1]]]], dtype=torch.float32
        )
        self.register_buffer("sobel_x", sobel_x)
        self.register_buffer("sobel_y", sobel_y)

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        grad_pred_x = F.conv2d(pred, self.sobel_x, padding=1)
        grad_pred_y = F.conv2d(pred, self.sobel_y, padding=1)
        grad_true_x = F.conv2d(target, self.sobel_x, padding=1)
        grad_true_y = F.conv2d(target, self.sobel_y, padding=1)
        return (
            F.mse_loss(grad_pred_x, grad_true_x) + F.mse_loss(grad_pred_y, grad_true_y)
        ) / 2


grad_loss = GradientLoss().to(device)

# Training loop
best_val = float("inf")
for epoch in range(30):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0
    for x, y in train_loader:
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        pred = model(x)
        loss = mse_loss(pred, y) + 0.2 * ssim(pred, y) + 0.1 * grad_loss(pred, y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += loss.item() * len(x)
    train_loss /= len(train_dataset)

    model.eval()
    val_rmse = 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for x, y in val_loader:
            x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
            pred = model(x)
            val_rmse += F.mse_loss(pred, y).item() * len(x)
    val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_rmse / len(val_dataset))
    scheduler.step(val_rmse)

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Train Loss: {train_loss:.5f}, Val RMSE: {val_rmse:.5f}")
    if val_rmse < best_val:
        best_val = val_rmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "working/best_model.pth")

# Generate submission
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("working/best_model.pth"))
model.eval()

submission = []
test_dir = Path("input/test")
for img_path in test_dir.glob("*.png"):
    img = Image.open(img_path).resize(TARGET_SIZE)
    img_tensor = to_tensor(img).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        pred = model(img_tensor).squeeze().cpu().numpy()

    base = img_path.stem
    h, w = pred.shape
    for row in range(h):
        for col in range(w):
            pixel_id = f"{base}_{row+1}_{col+1}"
            submission.append([pixel_id, pred[row, col]])

df = pd.DataFrame(submission, columns=["id", "value"])
df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler


class MDTA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, num_heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.temperature = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1, num_heads, 1, 1))
        self.qkv = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels * 3, kernel_size=1, bias=False)
        self.qkv_dwconv = nn.Conv2d(
            channels * 3,
            channels * 3,
            kernel_size=3,
            padding=1,
            groups=channels * 3,
            bias=False,
        )
        self.project_out = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, kernel_size=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, h, w = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv_dwconv(self.qkv(x))
        q, k, v = qkv.chunk(3, dim=1)
        q = q.reshape(b, self.num_heads, -1, h * w)
        k = k.reshape(b, self.num_heads, -1, h * w)
        v = v.reshape(b, self.num_heads, -1, h * w)
        q = torch.nn.functional.normalize(q, dim=-1)
        k = torch.nn.functional.normalize(k, dim=-1)
        attn = (q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.temperature
        attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
        out = (attn @ v).reshape(b, -1, h, w)
        return self.project_out(out)


class GDFN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, expansion_factor):
        super().__init__()
        hidden_channels = int(channels * expansion_factor)
        self.dwconv1 = nn.Conv2d(
            channels, hidden_channels, 3, padding=1, groups=channels, bias=False
        )
        self.act = nn.GELU()
        self.dwconv2 = nn.Conv2d(
            hidden_channels, channels, 3, padding=1, groups=channels, bias=False
        )
        self.project_out = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.dwconv1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.dwconv2(x)
        return self.project_out(x)


class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, num_heads, expansion_factor):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(channels)
        self.attn = MDTA(channels, num_heads)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(channels)
        self.ffn = GDFN(channels, expansion_factor)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.attn(self.norm1(x.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)).permute(0, 3, 1, 2))
        x = x + self.ffn(self.norm2(x.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)).permute(0, 3, 1, 2))
        return x


class Restormer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_chn=1, out_chn=1, blocks=2, heads=8, ffn_exp=2.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed = nn.Conv2d(in_chn, 32, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            *[TransformerBlock(32, heads, ffn_exp) for _ in range(blocks)]
        )
        self.down1 = nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 2, 2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            *[TransformerBlock(64, heads, ffn_exp) for _ in range(blocks)]
        )
        self.down2 = nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 2, 2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            *[TransformerBlock(128, heads, ffn_exp) for _ in range(blocks * 2)]
        )
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, 2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            *[TransformerBlock(64, heads, ffn_exp) for _ in range(blocks)]
        )
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(64, 32, 2, 2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            *[TransformerBlock(32, heads, ffn_exp) for _ in range(blocks)]
        )
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(32, out_chn, 3, padding=1, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.enc1(self.embed(x))
        x2 = self.enc2(self.down1(x1))
        x = self.bottleneck(self.down2(x2))
        x = self.dec1(self.up1(x) + x2)
        x = self.dec2(self.up2(x) + x1)
        return self.out(x)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames=None, transform=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames or os.listdir(noisy_dir)
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.filenames[idx])).convert(
            "L"
        )
        clean = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.filenames[idx])).convert(
            "L"
        )
        if self.transform:
            seed = torch.randint(0, 2**32, ())
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy = self.transform(noisy)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            clean = self.transform(clean)
        return noisy, clean

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
from torchvision import transforms, models
import torch.nn.functional as F


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, F_g, F_l, F_int):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(F_g, F_int, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int))
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(F_l, F_int, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int))
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return x * psi


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)

        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn3 = AttentionBlock(256, 256, 128)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn2 = AttentionBlock(128, 128, 64)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn1 = AttentionBlock(64, 64, 32)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool(e2))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool(e3))

        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(b), self.attn3(self.up3(b), e3)], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), self.attn2(self.up2(d3), e2)], 1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), self.attn1(self.up1(d2), e1)], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.sigma = sigma
        self.channel = 1
        self.window = self.create_window()

    def gaussian(self, window_size, sigma):
        x = torch.arange(window_size) - window_size // 2
        g = torch.exp(-0.5 * (x / sigma) ** 2)
        g = g.ger(g)
        return g / g.sum()

    def create_window(self):
        window = self.gaussian(self.window_size, self.sigma)
        return window.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        window = self.window.to(y_pred.device)
        mu_pred = F.conv2d(
            y_pred, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=self.channel
        )
        mu_true = F.conv2d(
            y_true, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=self.channel
        )
        mu_pred_sq = mu_pred.pow(2)
        mu_true_sq = mu_true.pow(2)
        mu_pred_mu_true = mu_pred * mu_true

        sigma_pred_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_pred * y_pred,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_pred_sq
        )
        sigma_true_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_true * y_true,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_true_sq
        )
        sigma_pred_true = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_pred * y_true,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_pred_mu_true
        )

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2
        ssim = ((2 * mu_pred_mu_true + C1) * (2 * sigma_pred_true + C2)) / (
            (mu_pred_sq + mu_true_sq + C1) * (sigma_pred_sq + sigma_true_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim.mean()


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):

        else:

        return noisy, clean

class DenoiseNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.up1 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128 + 128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.up2 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128 + 64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        p1 = self.pool1(e1)
        e2 = self.enc2(p1)
        p2 = self.pool2(e2)
        u1 = self.up1(p2)
        c1 = torch.cat([u1, e2], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(c1)
        u2 = self.up2(d1)
        c2 = torch.cat([u2, e1], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(c2)
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d2))


class DocumentDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_files, clean_files, transform=False):
        self.noisy_files = noisy_files
        self.clean_files = clean_files
        self.transform = transform

            clean = rotate(clean, angle)

                clean = hflip(clean)
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                noisy = vflip(noisy)
                clean = vflip(clean)

        return to_tensor(noisy), to_tensor(clean)

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class AttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, F_g, F_l, F_int):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(F_g, F_int, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int))
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(F_l, F_int, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int))
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, 1), nn.BatchNorm2d(1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return x * psi


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)

        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn3 = AttentionBlock(256, 256, 128)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn2 = AttentionBlock(128, 128, 64)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.attn1 = AttentionBlock(64, 64, 32)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool(e2))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool(e3))

        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(b), self.attn3(self.up3(b), e3)], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), self.attn2(self.up2(d3), e2)], 1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), self.attn1(self.up1(d2), e1)], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))


class MSSSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5, levels=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.sigma = sigma
        self.levels = levels
        self.channel = 1
        self.window = self.create_window()
        self.weights = torch.tensor([0.0448, 0.2856, 0.3001, 0.2363, 0.1333])

    def gaussian(self, window_size, sigma):
        x = torch.arange(window_size) - window_size // 2
        g = torch.exp(-0.5 * (x / sigma) ** 2)
        g = g.ger(g)
        return g / g.sum()

    def create_window(self):
        window = self.gaussian(self.window_size, self.sigma)
        return window.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)

    def ssim_single(self, y_pred, y_true):
        window = self.window.to(y_pred.device)
        mu_pred = F.conv2d(
            y_pred, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=self.channel
        )
        mu_true = F.conv2d(
            y_true, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=self.channel
        )
        mu_pred_sq = mu_pred.pow(2)
        mu_true_sq = mu_true.pow(2)
        mu_pred_mu_true = mu_pred * mu_true

        sigma_pred_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_pred * y_pred,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_pred_sq
        )
        sigma_true_sq = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_true * y_true,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_true_sq
        )
        sigma_pred_true = (
            F.conv2d(
                y_pred * y_true,
                window,
                padding=self.window_size // 2,
                groups=self.channel,
            )
            - mu_pred_mu_true
        )

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2
        ssim_map = ((2 * mu_pred_mu_true + C1) * (2 * sigma_pred_true + C2)) / (
            (mu_pred_sq + mu_true_sq + C1) * (sigma_pred_sq + sigma_true_sq + C2)
        )
        return ssim_map.mean([1, 2, 3])

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        self.weights = self.weights.to(y_pred.device)
        msssim = []
        for i in range(self.levels):
            if i > 0:
                y_pred = F.avg_pool2d(y_pred, kernel_size=2)
                y_true = F.avg_pool2d(y_true, kernel_size=2)
            ssim_val = self.ssim_single(y_pred, y_true)
            if i == 0:
                msssim.append(ssim_val ** self.weights[i])
            else:
                msssim[i] = msssim[i - 1] * (ssim_val ** self.weights[i])
        return 1 - msssim[-1].mean()

import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torchvision.transforms.functional import rotate, hflip, vflip, to_tensor
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import random

random.seed(42)
np.random.seed(42)
torch.manual_seed(42)

TARGET_SIZE = (540, 420)
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = self.gaussian(window_size, sigma).to(device)
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.C1 = 0.01**2
        self.C2 = 0.03**2

    def gaussian(self, size, sigma):
        gauss = torch.exp(
            -((torch.arange(size).float() - size // 2) ** 2) / (2 * sigma**2)
        )
        return gauss / gauss.sum()

    def forward(self, img1, img2):
        B, C, H, W = img1.shape
        window = self.window.view(1, 1, 1, -1).repeat(C, 1, self.window_size, 1)

        mu1 = F.conv2d(img1, window, padding=(0, self.window_size // 2), groups=C)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(img2, window, padding=(0, self.window_size // 2), groups=C)

        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu1_mu2 = mu1 * mu2

        sigma1_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img1, window, padding=(0, self.window_size // 2), groups=C)
            - mu1_sq
        )
        sigma2_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img2 * img2, window, padding=(0, self.window_size // 2), groups=C)
            - mu2_sq
        )
        sigma12 = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img2, window, padding=(0, self.window_size // 2), groups=C)
            - mu1_mu2
        )

        ssim_map = ((2 * mu1_mu2 + self.C1) * (2 * sigma12 + self.C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + self.C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + self.C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim_map.mean()


class DenoiseNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.up1 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128 + 128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.up2 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2, mode="bilinear", align_corners=True)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128 + 64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        p1 = self.pool1(e1)
        e2 = self.enc2(p1)
        p2 = self.pool2(e2)
        u1 = self.up1(p2)
        c1 = torch.cat([u1, e2], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(c1)
        u2 = self.up2(d1)
        c2 = torch.cat([u2, e1], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(c2)
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d2))


class DocumentDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_files, clean_files, transform=False):
        self.noisy_files = noisy_files
        self.clean_files = clean_files
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.noisy_files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy = Image.open(self.noisy_files[idx]).resize(TARGET_SIZE)
        clean = Image.open(self.clean_files[idx]).resize(TARGET_SIZE)

        if self.transform:
            angle = random.uniform(-10, 10)
            noisy = rotate(noisy, angle)
            clean = rotate(clean, angle)
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                noisy = hflip(noisy)
                clean = hflip(clean)
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                noisy = vflip(noisy)
                clean = vflip(clean)

        return to_tensor(noisy), to_tensor(clean)
