class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=1, out_channels=1, init_features=32):
        super().__init__()
        features = init_features

        # Encoder
        self.encoder1 = ResidualBlock(in_channels, features)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder2 = ResidualBlock(features, features * 2)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder3 = ResidualBlock(features * 2, features * 4)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder4 = ResidualBlock(features * 4, features * 8)
        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(features * 8, features * 16)

        # Decoder
        self.upconv4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 16, features * 8, 2, 2)
        self.decoder4 = ResidualBlock(features * 16, features * 8)
        self.upconv3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 8, features * 4, 2, 2)
        self.decoder3 = ResidualBlock(features * 8, features * 4)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 4, features * 2, 2, 2)
        self.decoder2 = ResidualBlock(features * 4, features * 2)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 2, features, 2, 2)
        self.decoder1 = ResidualBlock(features * 2, features)

        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(features, out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        enc1 = self.encoder1(x)
        enc2 = self.encoder2(self.pool1(enc1))
        enc3 = self.encoder3(self.pool2(enc2))
        enc4 = self.encoder4(self.pool3(enc3))

        # Bottleneck
        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool4(enc4))

        # Decoder
        dec4 = self.upconv4(bottleneck)
        dec4 = torch.cat((dec4, enc4), dim=1)
        dec4 = self.decoder4(dec4)
        dec3 = self.upconv3(dec4)
        dec3 = torch.cat((dec3, enc3), dim=1)
        dec3 = self.decoder3(dec3)
        dec2 = self.upconv2(dec3)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)
        dec2 = self.decoder2(dec2)
        dec1 = self.upconv1(dec2)
        dec1 = torch.cat((dec1, enc1), dim=1)
        dec1 = self.decoder1(dec1)

        return self.final_conv(dec1)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames=None, transform=None):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames if filenames else os.listdir(noisy_dir)
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, self.filenames[idx])).convert(
            "L"
        )
        clean = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, self.filenames[idx])).convert(
            "L"
        )

        if self.transform:
            seed = torch.randint(0, 2**32, ())
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            noisy = self.transform(noisy)
            torch.manual_seed(seed)
            clean = self.transform(clean)
        else:
            base_transform = transforms.Compose(
                [transforms.Resize((416, 544)), transforms.ToTensor()]
            )
            noisy = base_transform(noisy)
            clean = base_transform(clean)

        return noisy, clean

class ChannelAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.max_pool = nn.AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = (
            self.fc(self.avg_pool(x).view(x.size(0), -1)).unsqueeze(2).unsqueeze(3)
        )
        max_out = (
            self.fc(self.max_pool(x).view(x.size(0), -1)).unsqueeze(2).unsqueeze(3)
        )
        return x * (avg_out + max_out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(64),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),

            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),

            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 512, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(512),
            nn.Conv2d(512, 512, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(512, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(256),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(128),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(64),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        p1 = self.pool1(e1)
        e2 = self.enc2(p1)
        p2 = self.pool2(e2)
        e3 = self.enc3(p2)
        p3 = self.pool3(e3)
        b = self.bottleneck(p3)
        d3 = self.up3(b)
        d3 = F.pad(d3, [e3.size(3) - d3.size(3), 0, e3.size(2) - d3.size(2), 0])
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([d3, e3], 1))
        d2 = self.up2(d3)
        d2 = F.pad(d2, [e2.size(3) - d2.size(3), 0, e2.size(2) - d2.size(2), 0])
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([d2, e2], 1))
        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = F.pad(d1, [e1.size(3) - d1.size(3), 0, e1.size(2) - d1.size(2), 0])
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([d1, e1], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.decoder2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.decoder1 = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(128, 64), nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.encoder1(x)
        p1 = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.encoder2(p1)
        p2 = self.pool2(enc2)
        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(p2)

        up2 = self.upconv2(bottleneck)
        up2 = torch.cat([enc2, up2], dim=1)
        dec2 = self.decoder2(up2)

        up1 = self.upconv1(dec2)
        up1 = torch.cat([enc1, up1], dim=1)
        dec1 = self.decoder1(up1)
        return dec1


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, img_dir, clean_dir, transform=None, augment=False, filenames=None
    ):
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = sorted(os.listdir(img_dir)) if filenames is None else filenames
        self.transform = transform
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, filename)
        clean_path = os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename)
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("L")
        target = Image.open(clean_path).convert("L")

        if self.transform:
            image = self.transform(image)
            target = self.transform(target)

        if self.augment:
            angle = random.uniform(-5, 5)
            hflip = random.random() < 0.5
            vflip = random.random() < 0.5

            image = transforms.functional.rotate(image, angle)
            target = transforms.functional.rotate(target, angle)
            if hflip:
                image = transforms.functional.hflip(image)
                target = transforms.functional.hflip(target)
            if vflip:
                image = transforms.functional.vflip(image)
                target = transforms.functional.vflip(target)

        return image, target

        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([d3, e3], 1))
        d2 = self.up2(d3)
        d2 = F.pad(d2, [e2.size(3) - d2.size(3), 0, e2.size(2) - d2.size(2), 0])
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([d2, e2], 1))
        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = F.pad(d1, [e1.size(3) - d1.size(3), 0, e1.size(2) - d1.size(2), 0])
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([d1, e1], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))

from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import torchvision.transforms as transforms
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import torch.nn.functional as F


class SSIM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.sigma = sigma
        self.channel = 1
        self.register_buffer("window", self.create_window(window_size, sigma))

    def gaussian(self, window_size, sigma):
        gauss = torch.Tensor(
            [
                np.exp(-((x - window_size // 2) ** 2) / (2 * sigma**2))
                for x in range(window_size)
            ]
        )
        return gauss / gauss.sum()

    def create_window(self, window_size, sigma):
        _1D_window = self.gaussian(window_size, sigma).unsqueeze(1)
        _2D_window = _1D_window.mm(_1D_window.t()).float().unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
        return _2D_window.expand(1, 1, window_size, window_size).contiguous()

    def forward(self, img1, img2):
        (_, channel, _, _) = img1.size()
        window = self.window

        mu1 = F.conv2d(img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=channel)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=channel)

        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu1_mu2 = mu1 * mu2

        sigma1_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img1, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=channel)
            - mu1_sq
        )
        sigma2_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img2 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=channel)
            - mu2_sq
        )
        sigma12 = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img2, window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=channel)
            - mu1_mu2
        )

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2

        ssim_map = ((2 * mu1_mu2 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim_map.mean()


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=1, out_channels=1, init_features=32):
        super().__init__()
        features = init_features

        self.encoder1 = ResidualBlock(in_channels, features)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder2 = ResidualBlock(features, features * 2)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder3 = ResidualBlock(features * 2, features * 4)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder4 = ResidualBlock(features * 4, features * 8)
        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(features * 8, features * 16)

        self.upconv4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 16, features * 8, 2, 2)
        self.decoder4 = ResidualBlock(features * 16, features * 8)
        self.upconv3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 8, features * 4, 2, 2)
        self.decoder3 = ResidualBlock(features * 8, features * 4)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 4, features * 2, 2, 2)
        self.decoder2 = ResidualBlock(features * 4, features * 2)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 2, features, 2, 2)
        self.decoder1 = ResidualBlock(features * 2, features)

        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(features, out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.encoder1(x)
        enc2 = self.encoder2(self.pool1(enc1))
        enc3 = self.encoder3(self.pool2(enc2))
        enc4 = self.encoder4(self.pool3(enc3))

        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool4(enc4))

        dec4 = self.upconv4(bottleneck)
        dec4 = torch.cat((dec4, enc4), dim=1)
        dec4 = self.decoder4(dec4)
        dec3 = self.upconv3(dec4)
        dec3 = torch.cat((dec3, enc3), dim=1)
        dec3 = self.decoder3(dec3)
        dec2 = self.upconv2(dec3)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)
        dec2 = self.decoder2(dec2)
        dec1 = self.upconv1(dec2)
        dec1 = torch.cat((dec1, enc1), dim=1)
        dec1 = self.decoder1(dec1)

        return self.final_conv(dec1)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames=None, transform=None):

            noisy = base_transform(noisy)
            clean = base_transform(clean)

        return noisy, clean

import random
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
from torchvision import transforms
import torch.nn.functional as F


def gaussian(window_size, sigma):
    gauss = torch.Tensor(
        [
            np.exp(-((x - window_size // 2) ** 2) / float(2 * sigma**2))
            for x in range(window_size)
        ]
    )
    return gauss / gauss.sum()


def create_window(window_size, channel):
    _1D_window = gaussian(window_size, 1.5).unsqueeze(1)
    _2D_window = _1D_window.mm(_1D_window.t()).float().unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
    window = _2D_window.expand(channel, 1, window_size, window_size).contiguous()
    return window


def ssim(img1, img2, window_size=11, size_average=True):
    channel = img1.size(1)
    window = create_window(window_size, channel).to(img1.device)
    mu1 = F.conv2d(img1, window, padding=window_size // 2, groups=channel)
    mu2 = F.conv2d(img2, window, padding=window_size // 2, groups=channel)
    mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
    mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
    mu1_mu2 = mu1 * mu2
    sigma1_sq = (
        F.conv2d(img1 * img1, window, padding=window_size // 2, groups=channel) - mu1_sq
    )
    sigma2_sq = (
        F.conv2d(img2 * img2, window, padding=window_size // 2, groups=channel) - mu2_sq
    )
    sigma12 = (
        F.conv2d(img1 * img2, window, padding=window_size // 2, groups=channel)
        - mu1_mu2
    )
    C1 = 0.01**2
    C2 = 0.03**2
    ssim_map = ((2 * mu1_mu2 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)) / (
        (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
    )
    return ssim_map.mean() if size_average else ssim_map.mean(1).mean(1).mean(1)


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11):
        super().__init__()
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.channel = 1
        self.window = create_window(window_size, self.channel)

    def forward(self, img1, img2):
        (_, channel, _, _) = img1.size()
        if channel == self.channel and self.window.dtype == img1.dtype:
            window = self.window.to(img1.device)
        else:
            window = (
                create_window(self.window_size, channel)
                .to(img1.device)
                .type(img1.dtype)
            )
            self.window = window
            self.channel = channel
        return 1 - ssim(img1, img2, window_size=self.window_size)


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += residual
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.decoder2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.decoder1 = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(128, 64), nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.encoder1(x)
        p1 = self.pool1(enc1)
        enc2 = self.encoder2(p1)
        p2 = self.pool2(enc2)
        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(p2)

        up2 = self.upconv2(bottleneck)
        up2 = torch.cat([enc2, up2], dim=1)
        dec2 = self.decoder2(up2)

        up1 = self.upconv1(dec2)
        up1 = torch.cat([enc1, up1], dim=1)
        dec1 = self.decoder1(up1)
        return dec1


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, img_dir, clean_dir, transform=None, augment=False, filenames=None
    ):

                target = transforms.functional.hflip(target)
            if vflip:
                image = transforms.functional.vflip(image)
                target = transforms.functional.vflip(target)

        return image, target

import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import pandas as pd
import random
from math import exp

TARGET_SIZE = (540, 420)
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class ChannelAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.max_pool = nn.AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = (
            self.fc(self.avg_pool(x).view(x.size(0), -1)).unsqueeze(2).unsqueeze(3)
        )
        max_out = (
            self.fc(self.max_pool(x).view(x.size(0), -1)).unsqueeze(2).unsqueeze(3)
        )
        return x * (avg_out + max_out)


class SpatialAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, kernel_size=7):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(2, 1, kernel_size, padding=kernel_size // 2)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        max_out, _ = torch.max(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        combined = torch.cat([avg_out, max_out], dim=1)
        att = self.sigmoid(self.conv(combined))
        return x * att


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

        def conv_block(in_ch, out_ch, att=True):
            layers = [
                nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
                nn.ReLU(),
                ChannelAttention(out_ch) if att else nn.Identity(),
                SpatialAttention() if att else nn.Identity(),
                nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
                nn.ReLU(),
            ]
            return nn.Sequential(*layers)

        self.enc1 = conv_block(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = conv_block(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = conv_block(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.bottleneck = conv_block(256, 512)

        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = conv_block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = conv_block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = conv_block(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        p1 = self.pool1(e1)
        e2 = self.enc2(p1)
        p2 = self.pool2(e2)
        e3 = self.enc3(p2)
        p3 = self.pool3(e3)

        b = self.bottleneck(p3)

        d3 = self.up3(b)
        d3 = F.pad(d3, [e3.size(3) - d3.size(3), 0, e3.size(2) - d3.size(2), 0])
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([d3, e3], 1))

        d2 = self.up2(d3)
        d2 = F.pad(d2, [e2.size(3) - d2.size(3), 0, e2.size(2) - d2.size(2), 0])
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([d2, e2], 1))

        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = F.pad(d1, [e1.size(3) - d1.size(3), 0, e1.size(2) - d1.size(2), 0])
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([d1, e1], 1))

        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = self.create_window(window_size, sigma)
        self.window_size = window_size

    def gaussian(self, window_size, sigma):
        gauss = torch.Tensor(
            [
                exp(-((x - window_size // 2) ** 2) / (2 * sigma**2))
                for x in range(window_size)
            ]
        )
        return gauss / gauss.sum()

    def create_window(self, window_size, sigma):
        _1D = self.gaussian(window_size, sigma).unsqueeze(1)
        _2D = _1D.mm(_1D.t()).float()
        window = _2D.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
        return window.to(device)

    def forward(self, img1, img2):
        mu1 = F.conv2d(img1, self.window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(img2, self.window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)

        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu1_mu2 = mu1 * mu2

        sigma1_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img1, self.window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
            - mu1_sq
        )
        sigma2_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img2 * img2, self.window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
            - mu2_sq
        )
        sigma12 = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img2, self.window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
            - mu1_mu2
        )

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2

        ssim_map = ((2 * mu1_mu2 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim_map.mean()


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, augment=True):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_img = (
            Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename))
            .convert("L")
            .resize(TARGET_SIZE)
        )
        clean_img = (
            Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename))
            .convert("L")
            .resize(TARGET_SIZE)
        )

        if self.augment:
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                noisy_img = noisy_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
                clean_img = clean_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                angle = random.randint(-15, 15)
                noisy_img = noisy_img.rotate(angle)
                clean_img = clean_img.rotate(angle)
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                sigma = random.uniform(0.5, 1.5)
                noisy_np = np.array(noisy_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
                noisy_np += np.random.normal(0, sigma, noisy_np.shape).astype(
                    np.float32
                )
                noisy_np = np.clip(noisy_np, 0, 1)
                noisy_img = Image.fromarray((noisy_np * 255).astype(np.uint8))

        noisy = np.array(noisy_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        return torch.tensor(noisy).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(clean).unsqueeze(0)

class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channel, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channel, channel // reduction, bias=False),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Linear(channel // reduction, channel, bias=False),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, _, _ = x.size()
        y = self.avg_pool(x).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y).view(b, c, 1, 1)
        return x * y.expand_as(x)


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.se = SEBlock(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out = self.se(out)
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=1, out_channels=1, init_features=32):
        super().__init__()
        features = init_features

        self.encoder1 = ResidualBlock(in_channels, features)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder2 = ResidualBlock(features, features * 2)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder3 = ResidualBlock(features * 2, features * 4)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder4 = ResidualBlock(features * 4, features * 8)
        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(features * 8, features * 16)

        self.upconv4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 16, features * 8, 2, 2)
        self.decoder4 = ResidualBlock(features * 16, features * 8)
        self.upconv3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 8, features * 4, 2, 2)
        self.decoder3 = ResidualBlock(features * 8, features * 4)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 4, features * 2, 2, 2)
        self.decoder2 = ResidualBlock(features * 4, features * 2)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 2, features, 2, 2)
        self.decoder1 = ResidualBlock(features * 2, features)

        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(features, out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.encoder1(x)
        enc2 = self.encoder2(self.pool1(enc1))
        enc3 = self.encoder3(self.pool2(enc2))
        enc4 = self.encoder4(self.pool3(enc3))

        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool4(enc4))

        dec4 = self.upconv4(bottleneck)
        dec4 = torch.cat((dec4, enc4), dim=1)
        dec4 = self.decoder4(dec4)
        dec3 = self.upconv3(dec4)
        dec3 = torch.cat((dec3, enc3), dim=1)
        dec3 = self.decoder3(dec3)
        dec2 = self.upconv2(dec3)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)
        dec2 = self.decoder2(dec2)
        dec1 = self.upconv1(dec2)
        dec1 = torch.cat((dec1, enc1), dim=1)
        dec1 = self.decoder1(dec1)

        return self.final_conv(dec1)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames=None, transform=None):

        )

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, random_split
from torchvision import transforms


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        if self.downsample:
            identity = self.downsample(identity)
        out += identity
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)

class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channel, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channel, channel // reduction, bias=False),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Linear(channel // reduction, channel, bias=False),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, _, _ = x.size()
        y = self.avg_pool(x).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y).view(b, c, 1, 1)
        return x * y.expand_as(x)


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.se = SEBlock(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out = self.se(out)
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=1, out_channels=1, init_features=32):
        super().__init__()
        features = init_features

        self.encoder1 = ResidualBlock(in_channels, features)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder2 = ResidualBlock(features, features * 2)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder3 = ResidualBlock(features * 2, features * 4)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.encoder4 = ResidualBlock(features * 4, features * 8)
        self.pool4 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(features * 8, features * 16)

        self.upconv4 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 16, features * 8, 2, 2)
        self.decoder4 = ResidualBlock(features * 16, features * 8)
        self.upconv3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 8, features * 4, 2, 2)
        self.decoder3 = ResidualBlock(features * 8, features * 4)
        self.upconv2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 4, features * 2, 2, 2)
        self.decoder2 = ResidualBlock(features * 4, features * 2)
        self.upconv1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(features * 2, features, 2, 2)
        self.decoder1 = ResidualBlock(features * 2, features)

        self.final_conv = nn.Conv2d(features, out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.encoder1(x)
        enc2 = self.encoder2(self.pool1(enc1))
        enc3 = self.encoder3(self.pool2(enc2))
        enc4 = self.encoder4(self.pool3(enc3))

        bottleneck = self.bottleneck(self.pool4(enc4))

        dec4 = self.upconv4(bottleneck)
        dec4 = torch.cat((dec4, enc4), dim=1)
        dec4 = self.decoder4(dec4)
        dec3 = self.upconv3(dec4)
        dec3 = torch.cat((dec3, enc3), dim=1)
        dec3 = self.decoder3(dec3)
        dec2 = self.upconv2(dec3)
        dec2 = torch.cat((dec2, enc2), dim=1)
        dec2 = self.decoder2(dec2)
        dec1 = self.upconv1(dec2)
        dec1 = torch.cat((dec1, enc1), dim=1)
        dec1 = self.decoder1(dec1)

        return self.final_conv(dec1)


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames=None, transform=None):

        self.clean_dir = clean_dir

        )

        if self.transform:

        return noisy, clean


def gradient_loss(pred, target):
    sobel_x = torch.tensor(
        [[1, 0, -1], [2, 0, -2], [1, 0, -1]], dtype=torch.float32, device=pred.device
    ).view(1, 1, 3, 3)
    sobel_y = torch.tensor(
        [[1, 2, 1], [0, 0, 0], [-1, -2, -1]], dtype=torch.float32, device=pred.device
    ).view(1, 1, 3, 3)

    grad_x_pred = F.conv2d(pred, sobel_x, padding=1)
    grad_y_pred = F.conv2d(pred, sobel_y, padding=1)
    grad_x_target = F.conv2d(target, sobel_x, padding=1)
    grad_y_target = F.conv2d(target, sobel_y, padding=1)

    return F.mse_loss(grad_x_pred, grad_x_target) + F.mse_loss(
        grad_y_pred, grad_y_target
    )

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)

        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_ch != out_ch:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):

        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):

        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))

        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))

        d3 = self.up3(b)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3, e3], 1)
        d3 = self.dec3(d3)

import os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import pandas as pd
import random
from math import exp

TARGET_SIZE = (540, 420)
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class ChannelAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.max_pool = nn.AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = (
            self.fc(self.avg_pool(x).view(x.size(0), -1)).unsqueeze(2).unsqueeze(3)
        )
        max_out = (
            self.fc(self.max_pool(x).view(x.size(0), -1)).unsqueeze(2).unsqueeze(3)
        )
        return x * (avg_out + max_out)


class SpatialAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, kernel_size=7):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(2, 1, kernel_size, padding=kernel_size // 2)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        max_out, _ = torch.max(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        combined = torch.cat([avg_out, max_out], dim=1)
        att = self.sigmoid(self.conv(combined))
        return x * att


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

        def conv_block(in_ch, out_ch, att=True):
            layers = [
                nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
                nn.ReLU(),
                ChannelAttention(out_ch) if att else nn.Identity(),
                SpatialAttention() if att else nn.Identity(),
                nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
                nn.ReLU(),
            ]
            return nn.Sequential(*layers)

        self.enc1 = conv_block(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = conv_block(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = conv_block(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        self.bottleneck = conv_block(256, 512)

        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = conv_block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = conv_block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = conv_block(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        p1 = self.pool1(e1)
        e2 = self.enc2(p1)
        p2 = self.pool2(e2)
        e3 = self.enc3(p2)
        p3 = self.pool3(e3)

        b = self.bottleneck(p3)

        d3 = self.up3(b)
        d3 = F.pad(d3, [e3.size(3) - d3.size(3), 0, e3.size(2) - d3.size(2), 0])
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([d3, e3], 1))

        d2 = self.up2(d3)
        d2 = F.pad(d2, [e2.size(3) - d2.size(3), 0, e2.size(2) - d2.size(2), 0])
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([d2, e2], 1))

        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = F.pad(d1, [e1.size(3) - d1.size(3), 0, e1.size(2) - d1.size(2), 0])
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([d1, e1], 1))

        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11, sigma=1.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = self.create_window(window_size, sigma)
        self.window_size = window_size

    def gaussian(self, window_size, sigma):
        gauss = torch.Tensor(
            [
                exp(-((x - window_size // 2) ** 2) / float(2 * sigma**2))
                for x in range(window_size)
            ]
        )
        return gauss / gauss.sum()

    def create_window(self, window_size, sigma):
        _1D = self.gaussian(window_size, sigma).unsqueeze(1)
        _2D = _1D.mm(_1D.t()).float()
        window = _2D.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
        return window.to(device)

    def forward(self, img1, img2):
        mu1 = F.conv2d(img1, self.window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(img2, self.window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)

        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu1_mu2 = mu1 * mu2

        sigma1_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img1, self.window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
            - mu1_sq
        )
        sigma2_sq = (
            F.conv2d(img2 * img2, self.window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
            - mu2_sq
        )
        sigma12 = (
            F.conv2d(img1 * img2, self.window, padding=self.window_size // 2, groups=1)
            - mu1_mu2
        )

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2

        ssim_map = ((2 * mu1_mu2 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim_map.mean()


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, augment=True):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_img = (
            Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename))
            .convert("L")
            .resize(TARGET_SIZE)
        )
        clean_img = (
            Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename))
            .convert("L")
            .resize(TARGET_SIZE)
        )

        if self.augment:
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                noisy_img = noisy_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
                clean_img = clean_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                angle = random.randint(-15, 15)
                noisy_img = noisy_img.rotate(angle)
                clean_img = clean_img.rotate(angle)
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                sigma = random.uniform(0.5, 1.5)
                noisy_np = np.array(noisy_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
                noisy_np += np.random.normal(0, sigma, noisy_np.shape).astype(
                    np.float32
                )
                noisy_np = np.clip(noisy_np, 0, 1)
                noisy_img = Image.fromarray((noisy_np * 255).astype(np.uint8))

        noisy = np.array(noisy_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        return torch.tensor(noisy).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(clean).unsqueeze(0)


# Data setup
train_dir = "input/train"

criterion_mse = nn.MSELoss()

        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
        )

    def forward(self, x):

class UNet(nn.Module):

        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(128))

class PadToMultiple:
    def __init__(self, multiple=8, padding_mode="reflect"):
        self.multiple = multiple
        self.padding_mode = padding_mode

    def __call__(self, img):
        w, h = img.size
        new_w = ((w + self.multiple - 1) // self.multiple) * self.multiple
        new_h = ((h + self.multiple - 1) // self.multiple) * self.multiple
        padding = (0, 0, new_w - w, new_h - h)
        return transforms.functional.pad(img, padding, padding_mode=self.padding_mode)


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, out_ch):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1, padding_mode="reflect")
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1, padding_mode="reflect")
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)

        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if in_ch != out_ch:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch)
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        out = self.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
        out += residual
        return self.relu(out)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = ResidualBlock(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = ResidualBlock(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = ResidualBlock(128, 256)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = ResidualBlock(256, 512)

        # Decoder
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = ResidualBlock(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = ResidualBlock(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = ResidualBlock(128, 64)

        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))

        # Bottleneck
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))

        # Decoder
        d3 = self.up3(b)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3, e3], 1)
        d3 = self.dec3(d3)

        d2 = self.up2(d3)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e2], 1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)

        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e1], 1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)

        return self.final(d1)

        )

        d2 = self.dec2(d2)
        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e1], 1)

from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import pandas as pd
import random

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


# Model architecture remains the same as before
class ChannelAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.max_pool = nn.AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = (
            self.fc(self.avg_pool(x).view(x.size(0), -1)).unsqueeze(2).unsqueeze(3)
        )
        max_out = (
            self.fc(self.max_pool(x).view(x.size(0), -1)).unsqueeze(2).unsqueeze(3)
        )
        return x * (avg_out + max_out)


class SpatialAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, kernel_size=7):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(2, 1, kernel_size, padding=kernel_size // 2)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_out = torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        max_out, _ = torch.max(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        combined = torch.cat([avg_out, max_out], dim=1)
        att = self.sigmoid(self.conv(combined))
        return x * att


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

        def conv_block(in_ch, out_ch, att=True):
            return nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
                nn.ReLU(),
                ChannelAttention(out_ch) if att else nn.Identity(),
                SpatialAttention() if att else nn.Identity(),
                nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
                nn.ReLU(),
            )

        self.enc1 = conv_block(1, 64)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = conv_block(64, 128)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = conv_block(128, 256)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = conv_block(256, 512)
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = conv_block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = conv_block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = conv_block(128, 64)
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        p1 = self.pool1(e1)
        e2 = self.enc2(p1)
        p2 = self.pool2(e2)
        e3 = self.enc3(p2)
        p3 = self.pool3(e3)
        b = self.bottleneck(p3)

        d3 = self.up3(b)
        d3 = torch.cat([d3, e3], 1)
        d3 = self.dec3(d3)

        d2 = self.up2(d3)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e2], 1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)

        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e1], 1)
        d1 = self.dec1(d1)

        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))

    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, augment=True):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir

        clean_img = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename)).convert("L")

        noisy_img = noisy_img.resize(self.target_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        clean_img = clean_img.resize(self.target_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)

        if self.augment:
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                noisy_img = noisy_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
                clean_img = clean_img.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                angle = random.randint(-15, 15)
                # Rotate with expand and resize back to maintain size
                noisy_img = noisy_img.rotate(angle, expand=True).resize(
                    self.target_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS
                )
                clean_img = clean_img.rotate(angle, expand=True).resize(
                    self.target_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS
                )

        noisy = torch.tensor(
            np.array(noisy_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32
        ).unsqueeze(0)
        clean = torch.tensor(
            np.array(clean_img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32
        ).unsqueeze(0)
        return noisy, clean

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.conv(x)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(64))
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(128))
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(256))
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 512, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(512)
        )
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(512, 256, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(256))
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(128))
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(64))
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(b), e3], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), e2], 1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), e1], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):

            clean = self.transform(clean_img)
        else:
            noisy = transforms.ToTensor()(noisy_img)
            clean = transforms.ToTensor()(clean_img)

        return noisy, clean

import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import pandas as pd
import random

import torchvision.transforms.functional as TF

TARGET_SIZE = (540, 420)
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


# Model architecture remains unchanged from previous solution
class ChannelAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channel, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.max_pool = nn.AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channel, channel // reduction),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(channel // reduction, channel),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, _, _ = x.size()
        avg_out = self.fc(self.avg_pool(x).view(b, c))
        max_out = self.fc(self.max_pool(x).view(b, c))
        return x * torch.sigmoid(avg_out + max_out).view(b, c, 1, 1)


class SeparableConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, padding=0):
        super().__init__()
        self.depthwise = nn.Conv2d(
            in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size, padding=padding, groups=in_channels
        )
        self.pointwise = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.pointwise(self.depthwise(x))


class SpatialAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(2, 1, 7, padding=3)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_pool = torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        max_pool, _ = torch.max(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        combined = torch.cat([avg_pool, max_pool], dim=1)
        return x * self.sigmoid(self.conv(combined))


class DenoiseNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(64),
        )
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(128),
        )
        self.enc3 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(256),
        )
        self.spatial_attn = SpatialAttention()
        self.dec3 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(512, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(128),
        )
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(256, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(64),
        )
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(128, 1, 3, padding=1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(enc1)
        enc3 = self.enc3(enc2)
        attn = self.spatial_attn(enc3)
        dec3_in = torch.cat([enc3, attn], dim=1)
        dec3 = self.dec3(dec3_in)
        dec2_in = torch.cat([dec3, enc2], dim=1)
        dec2 = self.dec2(dec2_in)
        dec1_in = torch.cat([dec2, enc1], dim=1)
        return self.dec1(dec1_in)


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = torch.ones(window_size, window_size) / window_size**2
        self.window = self.window.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(device)

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        mu1 = F.conv2d(y_pred, self.window, padding=5)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(y_true, self.window, padding=5)
        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu12 = mu1 * mu2

        sigma1_sq = F.conv2d(y_pred * y_pred, self.window, padding=5) - mu1_sq
        sigma2_sq = F.conv2d(y_true * y_true, self.window, padding=5) - mu2_sq
        sigma12 = F.conv2d(y_pred * y_true, self.window, padding=5) - mu12

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2
        ssim = ((2 * mu12 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim.mean()


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, mode="train"):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.filenames = filenames
        self.mode = mode

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.filenames)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_pil = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename)).convert("L")
        clean_pil = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename)).convert("L")

        if self.mode == "train":
            i, j, h, w = transforms.RandomResizedCrop.get_params(
                noisy_pil, scale=(0.5, 1.0), ratio=(0.9, 1.1)
            )
            noisy_pil = TF.resized_crop(
                noisy_pil, i, j, h, w, TARGET_SIZE, TF.InterpolationMode.BILINEAR
            )
            clean_pil = TF.resized_crop(
                clean_pil, i, j, h, w, TARGET_SIZE, TF.InterpolationMode.BILINEAR
            )
        else:
            noisy_pil = noisy_pil.resize(TARGET_SIZE)
            clean_pil = clean_pil.resize(TARGET_SIZE)

        angle = random.uniform(-5, 5)
        noisy_pil = noisy_pil.rotate(angle)
        clean_pil = clean_pil.rotate(angle)

        if random.random() > 0.5:
            noisy_pil = noisy_pil.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
            clean_pil = clean_pil.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)

        brightness = random.uniform(0.9, 1.1)
        contrast = random.uniform(0.9, 1.1)
        noisy_pil = ImageEnhance.Brightness(noisy_pil).enhance(brightness)
        noisy_pil = ImageEnhance.Contrast(noisy_pil).enhance(contrast)

        noisy = np.array(noisy_pil, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean_pil, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        return torch.tensor(noisy).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(clean).unsqueeze(0)

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.conv(x)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(64))
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(128))
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(256))
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 512, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(512)
        )
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(512, 256, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(256))
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(128))
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(64))
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(b), e3], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), e2], 1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), e1], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))

TARGET_SIZE = (540, 420)

class EdgeLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.sobel_x = nn.Conv2d(1, 1, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.sobel_y = nn.Conv2d(1, 1, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.sobel_x.weight.data = torch.tensor(
            [[[[1, 0, -1], [2, 0, -2], [1, 0, -1]]]], dtype=torch.float32
        )
        self.sobel_y.weight.data = torch.tensor(
            [[[[1, 2, 1], [0, 0, 0], [-1, -2, -1]]]], dtype=torch.float32
        )
        self.sobel_x.requires_grad_(False)
        self.sobel_y.requires_grad_(False)

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        pred_edges_x = self.sobel_x(pred)
        pred_edges_y = self.sobel_y(pred)
        pred_edges = torch.sqrt(pred_edges_x**2 + pred_edges_y**2 + 1e-6)

        target_edges_x = self.sobel_x(target)
        target_edges_y = self.sobel_y(target)
        target_edges = torch.sqrt(target_edges_x**2 + target_edges_y**2 + 1e-6)

        return F.l1_loss(pred_edges, target_edges)


# Keep original model and dataset implementations unchanged
class ChannelAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channel, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.max_pool = nn.AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channel, channel // reduction),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(channel // reduction, channel),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, _, _ = x.size()
        avg_out = self.fc(self.avg_pool(x).view(b, c))
        max_out = self.fc(self.max_pool(x).view(b, c))
        return x * torch.sigmoid(avg_out + max_out).view(b, c, 1, 1)


class SeparableConv2d(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, padding=0):
        super().__init__()
        self.depthwise = nn.Conv2d(
            in_channels, in_channels, kernel_size, padding=padding, groups=in_channels
        )
        self.pointwise = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.pointwise(self.depthwise(x))


class SpatialAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(2, 1, 7, padding=3)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        avg_pool = torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        max_pool, _ = torch.max(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        combined = torch.cat([avg_pool, max_pool], dim=1)
        return x * self.sigmoid(self.conv(combined))


class DenoiseNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(64),
        )
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(128),
        )
        self.enc3 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(256),
        )
        self.spatial_attn = SpatialAttention()
        self.dec3 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(512, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(128),
        )
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(256, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ChannelAttention(64),
        )
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            SeparableConv2d(128, 1, 3, padding=1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        enc1 = self.enc1(x)
        enc2 = self.enc2(enc1)
        enc3 = self.enc3(enc2)
        attn = self.spatial_attn(enc3)
        dec3_in = torch.cat([enc3, attn], dim=1)
        dec3 = self.dec3(dec3_in)
        dec2_in = torch.cat([dec3, enc2], dim=1)
        dec2 = self.dec2(dec2_in)
        dec1_in = torch.cat([dec2, enc1], dim=1)
        return self.dec1(dec1_in)


class SSIMLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, window_size=11):
        super().__init__()
        self.window = torch.ones(window_size, window_size) / window_size**2
        self.window = self.window.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(device)

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        mu1 = F.conv2d(y_pred, self.window, padding=5)
        mu2 = F.conv2d(y_true, self.window, padding=5)
        mu1_sq = mu1.pow(2)
        mu2_sq = mu2.pow(2)
        mu12 = mu1 * mu2

        sigma1_sq = F.conv2d(y_pred * y_pred, self.window, padding=5) - mu1_sq
        sigma2_sq = F.conv2d(y_true * y_true, self.window, padding=5) - mu2_sq
        sigma12 = F.conv2d(y_pred * y_true, self.window, padding=5) - mu12

        C1 = 0.01**2
        C2 = 0.03**2
        ssim = ((2 * mu12 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)) / (
            (mu1_sq + mu2_sq + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
        )
        return 1 - ssim.mean()


class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, filenames, mode="train"):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir

        return len(self.filenames)

        filename = self.filenames[idx]
        noisy_pil = Image.open(os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename)).convert("L")
        clean_pil = Image.open(os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename)).convert("L")

        if self.mode == "train":
            i, j, h, w = transforms.RandomResizedCrop.get_params(
                noisy_pil, scale=(0.5, 1.0), ratio=(0.9, 1.1)
            )
            noisy_pil = TF.resized_crop(
                noisy_pil, i, j, h, w, TARGET_SIZE, TF.InterpolationMode.BILINEAR
            )
            clean_pil = TF.resized_crop(
                clean_pil, i, j, h, w, TARGET_SIZE, TF.InterpolationMode.BILINEAR
            )
        else:
            noisy_pil = noisy_pil.resize(TARGET_SIZE)
            clean_pil = clean_pil.resize(TARGET_SIZE)

        angle = random.uniform(-5, 5)
        noisy_pil = noisy_pil.rotate(angle)
        clean_pil = clean_pil.rotate(angle)

        if random.random() > 0.5:
            noisy_pil = noisy_pil.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)

        brightness = random.uniform(0.9, 1.1)

        noisy_pil = ImageEnhance.Contrast(noisy_pil).enhance(contrast)

        noisy = np.array(noisy_pil, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        clean = np.array(clean_pil, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        return torch.tensor(noisy).unsqueeze(0), torch.tensor(clean).unsqueeze(0)

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(channels),
        )

    def forward(self, x):

        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc3 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(256))
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 512, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(512)
        )
        self.up3 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(512, 256, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec3 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(512, 256, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(256))
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(128))
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1), ResidualBlock(64))
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool2(e2))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool3(e3))
        d3 = self.dec3(torch.cat([self.up3(b), e3], 1))
        d2 = self.dec2(torch.cat([self.up2(d3), e2], 1))
        d1 = self.dec1(torch.cat([self.up1(d2), e1], 1))
        return self.sigmoid(self.final(d1))

class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, files, is_train=True):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.files = files
        self.is_train = is_train

        return len(self.files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        noisy = Image.open(f"{self.noisy_dir}/{self.files[idx]}").convert("L")
        clean = Image.open(f"{self.clean_dir}/{self.files[idx]}").convert("L")

        pad_h = padded_h - noisy.height
        pad = transforms.Pad((0, 0, pad_w, pad_h), padding_mode="reflect")
        noisy_padded = pad(noisy)
        clean_padded = pad(clean)

        # Apply data augmentation if training
        if self.is_train:
            # Random horizontal flip

                noisy_padded = TF.hflip(noisy_padded)
                clean_padded = TF.hflip(clean_padded)

                noisy_padded = TF.vflip(noisy_padded)
                clean_padded = TF.vflip(clean_padded)
            # Random rotation
            angle = random.uniform(-5, 5)
            noisy_padded = TF.rotate(noisy_padded, angle, expand=False)
            clean_padded = TF.rotate(clean_padded, angle, expand=False)

        return transforms.ToTensor()(noisy_padded), transforms.ToTensor()(clean_padded)


class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(), nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1)
        )
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.enc2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
        )
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, 3, padding=1),
        )

        # Decoder
        self.up2 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(256, 128, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(256, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1),
        )
        self.up1 = nn.ConvTranspose2d(128, 64, 2, stride=2)
        self.dec1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(128, 64, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(), nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1)
        )
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(64, 1, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool1(e1))
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool2(e2))

        d2 = self.up2(b)
        d2 = torch.cat([d2, e2], 1)
        d2 = self.dec2(d2)
        d1 = self.up1(d2)
        d1 = torch.cat([d1, e1], 1)
        return self.final(self.dec1(d1))
